1.plot: The Snow Kids are losing 3-0 against the Red Tigers at half-time. They have to win this match if they want to qualify. Will Tia's return be enough to turn the situation around? Not if Artegor Nexus has anything to say about it.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E07 - Coach's Pet
1.plot: The tensions among the Snow Kids are making themselves felt: Micro-Ice is trying to get closer to Mei, but she has only one thing on her mind: becoming an attacker. Worse yet, the Snow Kids have to deal with the Rykers.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E08 - The Storm
1.plot: While the Shadows-Pirates game is in full swing, Aarch looks for the captain of his team, but to no avail. Rocket has disappeared. Tia thinks she knows where he could be hiding, but an enormous snowstorm is brewing outside.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E09 - Revenge Match
1.plot: Today the Snow Kids are playing the return match against the Rykers if they lose this match, our young heroes will advance no further in the competition. Micro-Ice's thoughts, however, have turned to Mei.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E10 - The Pirates
1.plot: The Snow Kids are traveling to play another legendary team: the Pirates of Shiloe. Since the Pirates are always on the move and ready to respond to any possible attack by Technoid, anything could happen.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E11 - The Professor
1.plot: During the return match against the Pirates, Rocket is injured. Clamp is somewhat distracted as he follows the match, and who could blame him? Memories of his past work for Technoid are coming back to him.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E12 - The Escape
1.plot: While Clamp is being kidnapped by Technoid robots, Sonny escapes through the ventilation duct and winds up face to face with Micro-Ice. Everyone at Aarch Academy is very worried: Aarch searches for Clamp, who suddenly reappears.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E13 - The Striker
1.plot: Snow Kids are up against the terrifying Shadows, and Micro-Ice still has not come back. Aarch is crazed with worry how will they play the match without him. D'Jok puts the blame on Mei, saying that it's her fault that Micro-Ice has left.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E14 - Black Hole
1.plot: Micro-Ice's return is a relief to everyone, because the Snow Kids are leaving immediately for the planet Shadows to play the return match. How will the Snow Kids play successfully under these conditions against Artegor's team.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E15 - Last Chance
1.plot: It's half time in the Snow Kids-Shadows match, and our young heroes have no energy left. They let the provocations of their opponents get to them and Thran seems exhausted they're losing 3-0. Only Rocket has managed to get his second wind.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E16 - Genesis Stadium
1.plot: These new and surprising conditions excite everyone, especially Mei, who has agreed to be a spokes-model for a brand of shampoo. But Tia has other things on her mind; armed with a photo of Rocket's mother, she goes to look for her.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E17 - Get Ready
1.plot: D'Jok has become the newest rising Galactik Football star, and he and his teammates are extremely confident before their upcoming match against the Wambas. Sonny and the Pirates have discovered why MetaFlux is so extremely important.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E18 - Under Pressure
1.plot: The match against the Wambas nearly turned into a complete fiasco. D'Jok really has let fame go to this head. Mei is being pressured by her mother to film new ads. And Tia has planned a surprise party for Rocket's birthday.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E19 - The Star
1.plot: The next match the Snow Kids will be playing against the Lightnings. Clamp who is still being held in a secret Technoid laboratory is getting sicker. Bleylock offers him an antidote that will allow him to live, but demands the Meta-Flux.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E20 - Metaflux
1.plot: The Snow Kids have qualified for the semi-final and the real Clamp is back. Unfortunately, he has some very bad news to report MetaFlux can be very dangerous to the health of players that use it. also D'Jok finds out that Sonny is his dad.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E21 - The Forfeit
1.plot: Aarch and his players are in serious trouble. Without MetaFlux, our young heroes seem to be losing control of the Breath of Akillian. They have no chance of winning the match against the Technoid team.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E22 - The Missing Link
1.plot: While the Pirate chief tries to put the MetaFlux in a safe place D'Jok confesses to Micro-Ice that Sonny Blackbones is his father. D'Jok's disappearance during the second semi-final between the Shadows and the Cyclopes makes Aarch worried.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E23 - Blackmail
1.plot: While almost all the parents have come to attend the party right before the final, D'Jok isolates himself. Mei can no longer approach him, and even the Pirates cannot convince him to speak to them. D'Jok is highly preoccupied.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E24 - The Duel
1.plot: Before the final Aarch is pessimistic about his team's chances of winning D'Jok is the most troubled of all if the Snow Kids win the final his father Sonny will die Sinedd seems to know about this terrible dilemma and makes D'Jok an offer.

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E25 - The Traitor
1.plot: The Snow Kids are just minutes away from the Galactik Football Cup final!. Will D'Jok really throw the game to save his father? Will Maya manage to convince him not to? Will the Pirates ally themselves with Technoid to save Sonny?

1.title: FR - Galactik Football - S01E26 - The Cup
1.plot: Everyone in Genesis Stadium is holding their breath D'Jok is going to shoot the free kick that will tie the score in the Galactik Football Cup final D'Jok is worn out. The Pirates have just arrived where Bleylock is holding Sonny prisoner.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E01 - Return to Genesis
2.plot: Four years after their triumphant victory in the Galactik Football Cup the Snow Kids return to Genesis Stadium and prepare to do it again but all is not well with the team. Ahito has a mysterious illness and may have to return to Akillian.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E02 - The Suspension
2.plot: Rocket saves Tia's life in Genesis Forest, but to do it, he uses The Breath. Yuki becomes the new Snow Kids' goalkeeper after Addim tells Aarch of the illegal use of The Breath. Aarch has no choice but to suspend Rocket indefinitely.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E03 - A Team Reinvented
2.plot: Aarch searches for a replacement for Rocket, but it's not easy. Rocket is irreplaceable. D'Jok suggests Mark from Akillian to step in. Sinedd introduces Rocket to Netherball a dangerous one-on-one football match played inside The Sphere.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E04 - The New Captain
2.plot: Clamp tells Sonny that he saw Bleylock alive. Sonny doesn't believe it, Aarch makes D'Jok the new captain of the Snow Kids in Rocket's absence; Tia takes it badly - The "friendly" between the Snow Kids and The Shadows is very unfriendly.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E05 - The Homecoming
2.plot: The Snow Kids go home to Akillian to surprise Ahito who is there recovering from his illness. The big news is Ahito's coming back to Genesis with the Snow Kids, but he's still not ready to play.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E06 - Netherball Rules!
2.plot: Back on Genesis, Norata blames Aarch for Rocket's disappearance. Rocket plays the Rykers's star Kernor - the current Netherball champion - in a brutal one-on-one match. Will she remain in The Sphere?

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E07 - Doubts Within
2.plot: The Snow Kids go to Addim saying that Rocket should not be suspended. It's announced that D'Jok will replace Rocket on the All-Star Team but D'Jok seems a bit too happy about it Mei reminds him of the real problem Rocket is still missing.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E08 - Rocket's Descent
2.plot: Plunging into the world of Netherball, Rocket plays Woowamboo of the Wambas. Will Rocket keep control of The Sphere? Sonny tells his men they need to find Rocket. Rocket may lead them to Bleylock - if Bleyok is alive.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E09 - The All-Stars
2.plot: The Snow-Kids watch the match on the Holo-TV: the All-Stars vs. the Technodroids V3s - Luur of the Xenons is very impressive; his flux, the Heat of Xenon is one of the most powerful forces in the galaxy.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E10 - Rocket vs. Sinedd
2.plot: Against the wishes of Bleylock and Harris, Sinedd plays Rocket in a rough match of Netherball. Will Sinedd control The Sphere? The pirates Arty and Bennett follow Wolfen and Zoran into the lower levels of Genesis Stadium.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E11 - The Champions Stumble
2.plot: Harris sneaks into Addim's office and places a video file on her computer to keep Rocket playing Netherball. The League votes to delay Rocket's return to the GFC, early in the match with the Wambas, the Snow Kids are losing.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E12 - Last Stand
2.plot: The Snow Kids are trailing the Wambas at the half and the team is very depressed especially D'Jok. It looks bad for our champions suddenly Ahito comes back and subs for Yuki in the second half Aarch pushes the Snow Kids to win the match.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E13 - Fluxless
2.plot: The Shadows/Pirates match begins, Bleylock orders his robots in a spacecraft to fire a flux device at the Shadows planet causing a huge explosion the Shadows suddenly lose their flux The Pirates easily beat the Shadows 7-2.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E14 - New Order
2.plot: After the explosion on the Shadows planet, and the Pirates GF team is disqualified. Rocket plays Luur in Netherball in a wicked obstacle match. D'Jok tells Rocket that he can play GF again, but Rocket tells him he's never coming back.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E15 - Revelations
2.plot: Tia discovers that Technoid is holding her parents prisoners Mei promises to help she introduces Tia to her special friend Corso The Xenons and the Cyclops play in the quarterfinals. Luur uses his flux, the Heat of Xenon to deadly results.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E16 - New Rules
2.plot: Dame Simbai informs him that the explosion on the Shadows planet was a flux device Sonny now knows what's behind Netherball. Aarch announces the new assistant coach for the Snow Kids Artegor Nexus who putting Yuki in Tia's vacant position.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E17 - Open Doors
2.plot: Tia is taken prisoner with Sonny and his pirates aboard the Technoid prison barge. She spots her parents in a nearby cell The Snow Kids play the Rykers in the quarterfinals match but Rocket has not come back and Tia is with the pirates.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E18 - Warren Steps In
2.plot: D'Jok competes in the Big Kicks Challenge in Genesis Stadium with other GF stars. D'Jok and Mark (and secretly Tia) go back down to watch Warren play Rocket in a brutal Netherball match with obstacles can Warren beat Rocket?

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E19 - The Technodroid V3s
2.plot: The Lightnings and the Technodroids V3s battle it out in their quarterfinals match. Yuki warms up to Micro-Ice to his shock. But they're late for practice again. D'Jok goes down to play Rocket in Netherball, but someone steps in his way.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E20 - The Fallen Star
2.plot: Tia bravely enters the Netherball Sphere to play Rocket but Rocket's too far gone. He's too wrapped up in the sport to know it's even her. Rocket plays harder than ever. Can Rocket be beaten? Will Tia survive the match?

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E21 - Coach Artegor
2.plot: The Snow Kids are thrilled to have Rocket back but Rocket is shocked to see Artegor coaching. After the Shadow's flux returns Artegor gets his wish The Shadow play the Xenons in their semifinals match can Shadows beat the invincible Xenons

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E22 - Rocket, the Midfielder
2.plot: Against Maya's wishes D'Jok plays in the Snow Kids semifinals match with the Lightnings. But on the pitch, Ahito falters could he still be sick As halftime approaches the Snow Kids are trailing Aarch is not sure that his team wants to win.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E23 - Destiny
2.plot: It's the second half of the semifinals match between the Snow Kids and the Lightnings and the Snow Kids are losing 2-0. Rocket rallies the team to everyone's surprise, and thanks to D'Jok's great idea, the Snow Kids fight back.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E24 - Final Preparations
2.plot: Sonny finds Bleylock in an alley. Now Sonny knows Bleylock's true intentions to destroy Genesis Stadium Snow kids parents are at Genesis expecting a night out with their children however the Snow Kids have their own plans.

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E25 - A Team Unravels
2.plot: Cup finals fever has hit Genesis Stadium despite the Snow Kids being the current champions the odds are on the Xenons and their power flux the Heat of Xenon meanwhile Arty and Bennett find Bleylock but lose the flux devices in Luna Genesis

2.title: FR - Galactik Football - S02E26 - Bleylock's Revenge
2.plot: Snow Kids play the second half time against Xenons D'Jok manages to tie the result to 2:2. Meanwhile, The Pirates chase Bleylock Can Snow Kids beat Xenons Harris is shown placing a flux device saying that one day they will rule the galaxy.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E01 - Stars in Danger
3.plot: The Snow Kids are on Akillian practicing for their upcoming friendly match against the Shadows. But they play without conviction. When explosions at Genesis Stadium sever the contact with Mei who was participating from a distance.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E02 - The Break-Up
3.plot: Mei still can't be found but then suddenly appears on Arcadia Sports along with Sinedd She announces that she is joining the Shadows and will participate in the Paradisia tournament Rocket, asks Artegor Nexus to help the Snow Kids.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E03 - Welcome to Paradisia
3.plot: Phoenix hopes to equip Paradisia with its own Flux but Vega reminds him that this has a price The teams are looking for new stars including the Snow Kids since Mei has joined the Shadows On the beach Rocket can't take his eyes off Lun-Zia

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E04 - A New Strategy
3.plot: In space Sonny and his pirates are being chased by the Paradisia security forces while D'Jok receives a tempting offer from Lord Phoenix Aarch and Artegor join the Snow Kids practice session to show them how it's done.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E05 - Resonance
3.plot: While Rocket and Tia are jogging on the beach, they meet Nikki 4, one of the players on the mysterious Team Paradisia Rocket finds her to be very strange, while practicing the Breath of Akillian Rocket suddenly collapses to the ground

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E06 - May the Show Begin!
3.plot: As the Shadows/Rykers and Elektras/Cyclops matches take place simultaneously at Deep Stadium and Dome Stadium, the pirates are caught in the "Phoenix Corporation" control room. Sonny discovers Lord Phoenix's real identity.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E07 - Fathers and Sons
3.plot: While Sonny, rescued by his pirates, remains in grave condition, D'Jok and the Snow Kids are preparing for their matches: Team Paradisia versus the Wambas, and the Snow Kids versus the Pirates. The Snow Kids are predicted to lose.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E08 - The Other Side of Paradisia
3.plot: On Paradisia, two exciting matches will pit the Xenons versus the Technodroids V4 and the Lightnings versus the "other" Akillian team, the Red Tigers. To everyone's surprise, the Red Tigers seem to have found the Breath.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E09 - The Secret of Deep Stadium
3.plot: The Xenons take on the Snow Kids in a quarterfinal match. In another quarterfinal match D'Jok and Team Paradisia battle Warren and the Lightnings. Sonny recovers and returns to try and stop the multi-flux plan.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E10 - Friends and Enemies
3.plot: Sinedd reveals his parents died during the earlier flux war and that he has never seen them, but they mysteriously reappear. The first semifinal is held between the Shadows and the Elektras.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E11 - Battle for the Final
3.plot: Tia and Mice learn of the multi-flux and try to help break the pirates out of Deep Dome The Snow Kids parents visit Paradisa to help relax their kids before the second semifinal match between the Snow Kids and Team Paradisia

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E12 - Betrayal on the Field
3.plot: Elsewhere Sonny corners Phoenix and forces him to reveal that multi-flux is in the core. It is believed Paradisia will be stable for a week, Brim Simbra, arrives and deems that Paradisia must be evacuated for everyone to be safe.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E13 - Endgame
3.plot: The championship begins The teams battle to a 2:0 Halftime score a robotic cat approaches Phoenix A hologram of Harris comes out and thanks Lord Phoenix for playing right into his trap massive earthquakes begin to rock Paradisia's surface.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E14 - A New Start
3.plot: The Snow Kids survive the blast and return to Akillian. Things don't look as bright for Brim Simbra and Lord Phoenix though. The two are officially declared dead. Brim Balarius is made the new head of the flux committee.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E15 - Crossed Fates
3.plot: In order to participate in the Cup LunZia must learn the Breath Mei must learn the Smog Yuki must learn the Wave Mei decides she can't tolerate the sickness Mei visits D'Jok who has started up football classes for young kids in the Genesis

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E16 - The Secrets of the Breath
3.plot: Shadows win their first game of the Cup 3:0, Mei reveals herself to her teammates as they board the shuttle. Snow Kids with Mei versus The Wambas, Clamp contacts Sonny and reveals the news that Harris is after the Cup.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E17 - Reconstituted Families
3.plot: D'Jok, Warren, and Artegor start Club Galactik, a youth camp teaching all the basics of Galactik Football but without the emphasis on heavy practice. Two matches are shown- the Pirates vs. the Red Tigers and the Cyclops vs. Team Paradisia.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E18 - Sinedd's Shadow
3.plot: A press conference is held announcing that D'Jok has rejoined the Snow Kids Mei learns that Sinedd's parents were fake Sinedd plays all out in the first half and gives the Shadows a 2:1 lead The Snow Kids walk away with a 3:2 in to advance

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E19 - The Ghost of Paradisia
3.plot: Clamp decides to go to Paradisia with Sonny to make sure they get the correct sample of multi-flux and to find Harvey's signal. The second quarterfinal between the Lightning and Team Paradisia takes place.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E20 - Walk for a Pirate
3.plot: Sonny and company begin looking for the human survivor on Paradisia. The survivor is none other than Magnus Blade in the Zenons/ Rykers quarterfinal game the Zenons advanced 3:2 and after that begins game Pirates/ Elektras.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E21 - Farewell, Paradisia
3.plot: The pirates escaping Paradisia with Magnus Blade In the escape Brim Simbra gets Sonny to promise he won't let the Multi-flux enter the cup. Brim Simbra passes away, and the Snow Kids/ Zenons semifinal match has its opening face-off.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E22 - All Together!
3.plot: The Snow Kids battle the Zenons in the first semifinal. The Pirates return Thran and Clamp to the Snow Kids at Halftime Adium sneaks out to see Aarch Magnus reveals that Team Paradisia is a group of cyborgs that contain the multi-flux

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E23 - Lost Illusions
3.plot: Aarch resigns as the coach of The Snow Kids so he can spend his time with Adium. Rocket moves from being a player to being the new coach of the Snow Kids. The second semifinal takes place between Team Paradisia and the Elektras.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E24 - The Second Chance
3.plot: Maya informs Sinedd his parents are still alive and that he has a little sister. She gets him to agree to meet with them. Magnus shows up to meet Harris thinking Harris will be there with a hologram. Sinedd rejoins the Snow Kids.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E25 - On All Fronts
3.plot: Aarch and Norata trace the bomb on Achillian to Arcadia, more specifically to Aarch's academy. The match between the Snow Kids and Team Paradisia begins, Aarch and Norata find the multi-flux bomb in the basement of his academy.

3.title: FR - Galactik Football - S03E26 - The Stars of Akillian Are Eternal
3.plot: D'Jok score for 1:1 and then Sinedd scores and Snow Kids win the cup 2:1 vs Team Paradisia. Pirates eliminates Harris's cat while then eliminates Harris and Vega who are knocked out into space. The Snow Kids win the cup 3 times in a row.

meta.plot: Cette série met en scène l'histoire d'une jeune équipe de football futuriste, les Snow Kids, qui va essayer de gagner la Galactik Football Cup pour leur planète Akillian, après s'être faite recruter par une ancienne légende du football. Mais pour ce faire, ils devront faire face à de nombreuses équipes bien plus aguerries que la leur comme les Shadows, les Lightnings ou les Wambas, et devront s'imposer comme la meilleure équipe. On suit alors leurs débuts de joueurs, de l'anonymat à la célébrité et leur évolution aussi bien dans le football que dans leur vie privée.

1.title: FR - For Life - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Prisoner Aaron Wallace becomes a lawyer, litigating cases for other inmates while fighting to overturn his own wrongful conviction.

1.title: FR - For Life - S01E02 - Promises
1.plot: Tensions rise between Aaron and his crew when he provides counsel to a white supremacist in order to repay his debt to inmate Wild Bill. District Attorney Maskins ups his game when Aaron sues the NYPD in an attempt to gain access to his case file. Meanwhile, his daughter’s boyfriend, Ronnie, braces for confrontation as he visits the prison to meet Aaron for the first time.

1.title: FR - For Life - S01E03 - Brother's Keeper
1.plot: Determined to gain access to his police file, Aaron decides to represent an inmate from Safiya’s drug rehabilitation program whose brother is a cop. District Attorney Maskins and Assistant District Attorney O’Reilly close in on proof of Aaron’s malfeasance during Jose Rodriguez’s trial, targeting Marie as a way to get to Aaron.

1.title: FR - For Life - S01E04 - Marie
1.plot: Taking us back nine years, Marie struggles in her marriage to Aaron as she deals with the turbulence of Aaron’s arrest, trial and incarceration.

1.title: FR - For Life - S01E05 - Witness
1.plot: While litigating on behalf of an inmate locked up on a robbery charge, Aaron is torn between doing what's right and what's best for his case. Heartened by Aaron's new lead, Marie recommits to his case, researching witnesses on Aaron's behalf. Plus, Safiya closes in on Foster's drug smuggling scheme.

1.title: FR - For Life - S01E06 - Burner
1.plot: Aaron confronts O'Reilly in court, targeting the search warrant used in Aaron's arrest and the DA's failure to disclose a confidential informant. Marie's father comes to town, intent on encouraging her and Darius to solidify their relationship. Maskins arranges for a dangerous inmate, Cassius Dawkins, to be transferred to Bellmore in hopes that he'll cause problems for Safiya and Aaron.

1.title: FR - For Life - S01E07 - Do Us Part
1.plot: Aaron struggles to balance the demands of his own case with the needs of an inmate who's fighting for the right to marry his dying girlfriend. Safiya defies the prison board, effectively jeopardizing Anya's campaign as well as their marriage.

1.title: FR - For Life - S01E08 - Daylight
1.plot: In order to maintain his lifeline to the outside world, Aaron is forced to defend Cassius Dawkins when he puts three white supremacists in the hospital; Marie struggles with her feelings for Aaron after he signs her divorce papers.

1.title: FR - For Life - S01E09 - Buried
1.plot: Aaron pushes to represent longtime inmate Easley Barton, hoping that winning this 23-year-old case against Maskins will strengthen his own. Captain Foster continues his drug-smuggling racket as Safiya closes in. Marie struggles with her breakup with Darius as she continues to help Aaron in his case.

1.title: FR - For Life - S01E10 - Character and Fitness
1.plot: Flashing back to the previous nine years of his incarceration, Aaron's journey from terrified novice prisoner to attorney and social crusader unfolds.

1.title: FR - For Life - S01E11 - Switzerland
1.plot: Aaron bolsters his case with newfound information from Marie; Cassius suspects Aaron is a snitch and seeks retribution; Foster struggles to lay low during his last two weeks before retirement, but Safiya turns up the heat.

1.title: FR - For Life - S01E12 - Closing Statement
1.plot: Aaron finally gets his chance to argue for his retrial in court, but it's thwarted by the return of prison warden Cyrus Hunt; Safiya deals with the aftermath of the prison riot and attempts to salvage her reforms.

1.title: FR - For Life - S01E13 - Fathers
1.plot: When Maskins and Cyrus Hunt try to thwart Aaron's attempt at a retrial, Aaron is forced to attempt a desperate move, risking the wrath of a powerful new adversary. The election comes to a head as Safiya tries to warn Aaron that he is now a marked man on the season finale

2.title: FR - For Life - S02E01 - Never Stop Fighting
2.plot: After nine years of fighting to win his freedom, it’s do or die for Aaron Wallace. As dangerous enemies lurk at Bellmore and Marie faces criminal charges for assisting Aaron in prior cases, Aaron must find a way to gain the upper hand on Maskins.

2.title: FR - For Life - S02E02 - Homecoming
2.plot: A newly liberated man, Aaron acclimates to family life outside of prison. As he attempts to help Jamal with his case, Aaron encounters Jamal’s sister who needs legal help of her own. Former nemesis Spencer Richardson proposes an intriguing work opportunity to Aaron and Roswell.

2.title: FR - For Life - S02E03 - The Necessity Defense
2.plot: At the urging of Spencer Richardson, Aaron defends a woman charged with holding hospital workers at gunpoint to secure lifesaving treatment for her son. Aaron and Marie navigate their newly intimate relationship, and a young social justice warrior joins Aaron and Roswell’s firm.

2.title: FR - For Life - S02E04 - Time to Move Forward
2.plot: As a favor to Jamal, Aaron defends a man in a witness tampering case, while tensions rise at home in the run-up to the Wallace family Thanksgiving.

2.title: FR - For Life - S02E05 - Collars for Dollars
2.plot: After Aaron and Roswell agree to help a young woman facing deportation for a minor crime, they realize her case could be a key to exposing a broad pattern of police corruption. Meanwhile, Jasmine begins to spend more time at Ronnie's house and Marie grapples with the first signs of an empty nest.

2.title: FR - For Life - S02E06 - 354
2.plot: After an urgent call from Bellmore concerning the growing COVID-19 pandemic, Aaron enlists Safiya’s help and heads back to the prison to investigate. Meanwhile Marie faces a choice: Expose her family to the virus or go all-in at the hospital.

2.title: FR - For Life - S02E07 - Say His Name
2.plot: Aaron takes on the case of an unarmed man shot by a police officer. Safiya represents Ronnie after he’s arrested and roughed up by law enforcement, and the family struggles with whether to have Aaron Jr. baptized.

2.title: FR - For Life - S02E08 - For the People
2.plot: Aaron faces pressure from all sides when he is forced to decide which charges to bring against the officers responsible for the killing of an unarmed civilian. While Safiya pursues video evidence that could change their case, Roswell searches for a way to move the case from Staten Island to a friendlier venue.

2.title: FR - For Life - S02E09 - The Blue Wall
2.plot: With Aaron and Marie facing threats from an increasingly hostile community, Aaron and his team double down by pursuing criminal charges against a high-ranking police officer they believe tried to cover up the shooting.

2.title: FR - For Life - S02E10 - Andy Josiah
2.plot: Aaron and his legal team face their toughest trial yet as they prosecute the police officer responsible for the killing of an innocent, unarmed Black man.

meta.plot: Accusé à tort de meurtre et envoyé en prison à vie, Aaron devient avocat depuis sa cellule et se sert de sa nouvelle occupation pour aider ses compagnons, mais aussi pour prouver son innocence. Sa quête de liberté est motivée par son désir de retrouver sa famille et de récupérer la vie qui lui a été arrachée. Injustement condamné, le détenu va devoir se heurter aux limites du système judiciaire.

1.title: FR - Haha, You Clowns - S01E01 - Movie Night
1.plot: The boys try to figure out why Dad can't stay awake during movie night.

1.title: FR - Haha, You Clowns - S01E02 - Viral
1.plot: The boys convince Dad to try and go viral during his weather report.

1.title: FR - Haha, You Clowns - S01E03 - Bomber Jacket
1.plot: Preston loses his beloved World War II bomber jacket.

1.title: FR - Haha, You Clowns - S01E04 - Plane
1.plot: Dad confronts his fear of flying on the way to Mexico.

1.title: FR - Haha, You Clowns - S01E05 - Duncan Holds a Baby
1.plot: Duncan struggles to hide his fear of holding babies.

meta.plot: Karl Alberg est un détective qui s'installe dans une paisible ville côtière pour apaiser un psychisme mis à mal par le travail de la police des grandes villes, mais ce doux paradis a plus que sa part de secrets, et Karl devra faire appel à toutes les compétences dont il a besoin. a fait de lui un détective de classe mondiale pour résoudre les meurtres qui, même dans ce cadre apparemment idyllique, continuent de s'échouer sur ses côtes.

meta.plot: Retour sur l'affaire non résolue du tueur en série le "Monstre de Florence", auteur de neuf doubles meurtres entre 1968 et 1985. Malgré les enquêtes, l'arme utilisée pour chaque meurtre - un Beretta de calibre 22 - n'a jamais été retrouvée et le tueur n'a jamais été arrêté.

1.title: FR - Allen Iv3rson [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: At a street naming ceremony in his honor, Allen Iverson returns to his hometown to reflect on his roots. Raised in poverty and violence in Hampton and Newport News, he overcame adversity to lead Bethel High to state titles. In 1993, a bowling alley brawl lands him in prison, sparking national outrage and a battle for his freedom.

1.title: FR - Allen Iv3rson [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Ann Iverson fights to free her son, seeking guidance from Georgetown coach John Thompson. Under Thompson’s mentorship, Allen rises to stardom. He leaves college early, is drafted #1 by the 76ers in 1996, and becomes Rookie of the Year. His rapid rise and cultural impact draw both praise and criticism, while tensions with coach Larry Brown escalate.

1.title: FR - Allen Iv3rson [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: The episode opens with Iverson’s Game 1 victory over the Lakers in the 2001 NBA Finals, earning national respect despite the loss. That year, he marries Tawanna Turner and mourns the murder of his close friend. Amid controversies, including the "practice" press conference and clashes with the NBA, Iverson stays true to himself, redefining the NBA and inspiring a new generation.

meta.plot: ALLEN IV3RSON raconte l'histoire de la légende de la NBA. Cette docu-série dévoile des images inédites et des interviews exclusives pour illustrer son ascension, d'une enfance marquée par la pauvreté à l'icône culturelle, avec ses sacrifices, sa résilience et sa loyauté sans faille envers sa famille et sa communauté, montrant comment il a redéfini le jeu et inspiré les générations à venir.

meta.plot: Après 17 ans de séparation, Gary Ewing et son ex-femme Valene ont décidé de reprendre la vie commune. Ils partent se fixer loin de Dallas dans une résidence proche de la mer à Knots Landing, en Californie. A peine installés dans leur nouvelle demeure, ils font la connaissance de leurs voisins, les Fairgate et les Avery. La petite communauté mène une vie plus ou moins paisible... jusqu'à l'arrivée de l'intrigante Abby Fairgate !

meta.plot: Le désir, l’ambition et la trahison traversent les générations chez les Forsyte, une famille aisée de courtiers en bourse, dont les membres, pris entre la tradition et la loyauté familiale, s’opposent souvent à leur propre quête de bonheur. Au fil des années, les tensions grandissent entre ceux qui sacrifient leurs sentiments pour préserver l’ordre établi et ceux qui osent poursuivre l’amour, quitte à briser les liens du sang et les conventions sociales.

2.title: FR - Ben 10 (2005) - S02E01 - Truth
2.plot: After the battle with Vilgax, Grandpa Max retells his story to Ben about his past. He was with an organization that was not known to exist, referred to as "The Plumbers," a group of people who track down extraterrestrial life. Meanwhile, they meet Phil, an old partner of Grandpa Max. But they soon find out that he steals a device, called the Null Void Projector, to selfishly use it to make money by appearing to capture aliens that he alone released himself.

2.title: FR - Ben 10 (2005) - S02E02 - The Big Tick
2.plot: At Yellowstone Park, Ben and Gwen inadvertently discover a new form on the Omnitrix: Cannon Bolt, an armadillo-like alien that Ben isn't too fond of. Soon after, a meteor comes crashing down to the park, containing a planet-devouring, tick-like alien. On top of that, three other aliens arrive with it, and worship it as their savior, the "Great One." Powerless to stop the planet-eater with his regular forms, Ben must rely on a new form he knows nothing about.

2.title: FR - Ben 10 (2005) - S02E03 - Framed
2.plot: At a city, Ben, Gwen, and Grandpa Max are waiting outside a video game store to purchase the newly-released Sumo Slammer video game. Gwen and Grandpa Max go the book store, but when they return to check on him, Four Arms comes out of the store by force. They return to the RV, and find that Ben is already there. Gwen yells at Ben for what he's done, but he has no clue of what she's talking about. But as she gives direct evidence that Four Arms was attacking the city, Ben heads out to find the perpetrator, using the identity of his aliens to ruin his current reputation as a hero.

2.title: FR - Ben 10 (2005) - S02E04 - Gwen 10
2.plot: In this "how 'bout?" episode, Gwen gets the Omnitrix and the power that comes with it.

2.title: FR - Ben 10 (2005) - S02E05 - Grudge Match
2.plot: In the middle of nowhere, Ben, as Diamond Head, fights Kevin 11, who is still in his mutated form. As they fight, they are taken to a ship, where a battle between different aliens are held. But when a mechanical droid named Slix decides to create a bond with Ben and Kevin as a team, they immediately turn his idea down. But with no choice, they must find a way out. Will Ben and Kevin learn the importance of teamwork?

2.title: FR - Ben 10 (2005) - S02E06 - The Galactic Enforcers
2.plot: At a museum, Ben sits and reads a comic, daydreaming about himself as a super hero. As Gwen interrupts him, she is not happy how Ben treats the artwork. His day has been a bore, but when an alien vessel arrives, an alien named Volcanus and the bounty hunter Sixsix come to pursue the Biocenthium alloy to complete a mixture with Element X to create a bomb, strong enough to destroy a whole solar system. Suddenly, Ben meets The Galactic Enforcers, a group of three who serve in protecting the galaxy under the conduct code. Ben is intrigued by their heroic appearance, but are they really something to be looking up to?

2.title: FR - Ben 10 (2005) - S02E07 - Camp Fear
2.plot: When Ben and Gwen argue over a birthday party to occur in the next few months, Grandpa Max is distracted by their quarreling and almost hits a young boy camper. To ensure the boy's life, they head to Camp Opinicon, only to find no people around. As they investigate the premises, they find twins, whom were also hiding from something that may have a connection to the lifeless camp. Grandpa Max readies to leave the area with the children, only to find that the RV's engine is clogged with a mysterious fungus. While the kids take in shelter in a nearby cabin, Grandpa Max is captured. Now Ben must come to the rescue to discover a new alien form, as well as a way to destroy the evil alien Myceloid Monsters and their Fungal Master, and learn the benefits of what sharing can do.

2.title: FR - Ben 10 (2005) - S02E08 - Ultimate Weapon
2.plot: In Texas, a group of men discover a mysterious mask belonging to Ah Puch, the Mayan god of death and destruction. The mask is the key to the ultimate weapon in the world, known as the Sword of Ekchuah. However, when Grandpa Max and his grandkids learn that the mask is discovered, he impatiently sets out to obtain the mask, so that it does not fall in the wrong hands. Unfortunately, they find out that Enoch of The Organization is after it as well. The kids worry of how Grandpa Max has become, but with Enoch in the way, will Grandpa Max find the sword before him?

2.title: FR - Ben 10 (2005) - S02E09 - Tough Luck
2.plot: Hex's niece, Charmcaster, enters the underground prison he's held at to release him out of his cell. With her help, Hex was able to regain most of his powers after being given his magical staff. Meanwhile, Ben, Gwen, and Grandpa Max head to a magic convention held in Las Vegas, and in there, Gwen finds the legendary Keystone of Bazell. With it, she gains the powers of Lucky Girl once again, but will it last after finding out that Hex and his niece are after it?

2.title: FR - Ben 10 (2005) - S02E10 - They Lurk Below
2.plot: Our heroes ride a jet belonging to Grandpa Max's old Friend, Donovan Grand Smith, who owns an underwater resort. At the entrance, they receive a warm welcome from Donovan himself, though they also meet with his grandson, Edwin, who didn't seem to be excited about their guests. Later, when Edwin, Ben, and Gwen enter the Undersea Manta Ray, a giant submarine, they encounter strange aliens that threatened to destroy the whole resort. While the kids find a way to cooperate with each other to find the source that lures them in, Donovan himself learns a few lessons in how to bond better with his grandson.

2.title: FR - Ben 10 (2005) - S02E11 - Ghostfreaked Out
2.plot: A terrorizing nightmare of Ghostfreak is half the trouble for an unnerved Ben, as a tour of an important academy that Gwen wishes to attend is disturbed by the uncanny alien's manifestations and the antics of Acid Breath, Frightwig, and Thumbskull.

2.title: FR - Ben 10 (2005) - S02E12 - Dr. Animo and the Mutant Ray
2.plot: The Tennysons arrive at a swamp, where a festivities of Gatorfest start first thing the next day. Gwen finds Ben playing around with the Omnitrix, and she warns him that it may create unusual problems. Without heeding Max and Gwen's warning, he pops the face out, and the Omnitrix acts up. Right away, something was wrong, though it was gone unnoticed, at least, until the next day. Gator-fest was going along well, but the giant frog of Dr. Animo comes in to disrupt it. Dr. Animo has returned, and he wants to take revenge on Ben. But when Ben goes alien, he transforms into a hybrid alien with unbalanced attributes. Will Ben ever learn his lesson in listening for a change?

2.title: FR - Ben 10 (2005) - S02E13 - Back With a Vengeance
2.plot: The Megacruiser flies solo in space, and inside Kevin examines the giant ice block found in space. Inside the mass, held Vilgax, and Kevin underestimated his current situation. He was very much alive and well, and they soon create a partnership after learning that they were both after the same person. On Earth, Ben plays around with the Omnitrix, hoping to find a better way of controlling it. Eventually, he finds the master control of the Omnitrix, giving him the ability to alternate between aliens, as well as prolong his duration with a form. Although his discovery has given him a stronger advantage, will it be enough to stop the danger that lies ahead?

3.title: FR - Ben 10 (2005) - S03E01 - Ben 10,000
3.plot: When Gwen is abducted, Ben as XLR8 follows her abductor to the future where they discovered that her abductor is the future Gwen and they discover his future version of Ben and Grandpa Max. In the future, Dr. Animo revives Vilgax and plots to open the Null Void chamber. Both Bens must work together to stop them.

3.title: FR - Ben 10 (2005) - S03E02 - Midnight Madness
3.plot: When Ben is hypnotized, he begins breaking the law while sleepwalking. Once the evil hypnotist called Sublimino discovers the aliens at his disposal, he plots to put hundreds of people under his control forever.

3.title: FR - Ben 10 (2005) - S03E03 - A Change of Face
3.plot: Dressed as Pilgrims, to honor their history, while in the streets of Salem, MA, Ben, Gwen, and Grandpa Max witness an explosion of a nearby building. But when Ben rushes to the rescue, Charmcaster is there waiting with a spell to take over Ben's body and the Omnitrix. Only things go awry and Gwen and Charmcaster switch bodies. Gwen goes to prison and the sorceress is brewing a plan to gain the Omnitrix. Now Gwen must find the way to get out of prison, alert her family against Charmcaster, and get her own body back using every trick up her sleeve... or Charmcaster's.

3.title: FR - Ben 10 (2005) - S03E04 - Merry Christmas
3.plot: Ben, Grandpa Max, and Gwen come upon a bizarre Christmas theme park run by an evil entity who thinks Grandpa Max is Santa Claus and proceeds to trap him.

3.title: FR - Ben 10 (2005) - S03E05 - Benwolf
3.plot: Ben, as Wildvine, is fighting against an evil werewolf and is bitten. The Omnitrix times out and Ben turns back to his human form. Then, when the werewolf hits the Omnitrix, it starts to mess up and act weird. After all of this, Ben starts to get a crush on a girl that he meets. But things change, as Ben slowly starts to turn into a werewolf himself.

3.title: FR - Ben 10 (2005) - S03E06 - Game Over
3.plot: The Tennysons stay in as it rains outside, and Ben plays a video game to pass the time by. When Gwen decides to join in, Ben is jealous of how she's a far superior player. Instead, Ben decides to transform to Upgrade, and merges with the game console. Gwen makes an attempt at shaking him off, but suddenly, a lightning strike causes them to transfer into the video game itself. The only way Ben can use the Omnitrix is to find coins with the different aliens on it. To get out, they must find the Upgrade coin before an evil being uses it to escape into the real world.

3.title: FR - Ben 10 (2005) - S03E07 - Super Alien Hero Buddy Adventures
3.plot: Ben's alien heroes are starring in a silly network cartoon called Super Alien Hero Buddy Adventures and his favorite action hero Kangaroo Commando has been pulled off the air by the same network, so Ben tries to get him back on television and get credit for the alien heroes.

3.title: FR - Ben 10 (2005) - S03E08 - Under Wraps
3.plot: In order for Ben and Gwen to learn the value of hard work, Grandpa Max takes them to a farm. Meanwhile, an alien mummy arrives to uncover a rare and dangerous element.

3.title: FR - Ben 10 (2005) - S03E09 - The Unnaturals
3.plot: While attending the Little League World Series to see his home team play, Ben discovers that the opponents are actually robots posing as kids. They also have plans to replace the President with one, as well.

3.title: FR - Ben 10 (2005) - S03E10 - Monster Weather
3.plot: Grandpa Max takes the kids to Chicago to see one of his favorite band, Shag Carpeting. The kids meet a weather reporter who forecasts the weather with a robot named S.A.M. He uses the robot to create rain, but a giant creature forms! Ben quickly takes care of it. The reporter tries to destroy S.A.M., but he convinces him not to. S.A.M. then goes into the sky and begins to cause chaos. The reporter tries to stop it again, but he is no longer in control. Can Ben destroy the robot and save a city from disaster?

3.title: FR - Ben 10 (2005) - S03E11 - The Return
3.plot: While driving on a Florida highway, a bus of escaped felons rams into the RV. Ben transforms into Stinkfly (though not intentionally) and tries to stop them. With a little help from Grandpa's handy driving, and a magic spell from Gwen, the felons are put back in jail. On the news, the Tennyson's hear about purple lightning delaying a space shuttle launch. Remembering the lightning from the encounter with the werewolf and mummy aliens, they head to Cape Canaveral. At the Space Center, Ben comes under attack by the werewolf and mummy aliens, and new Frankenstein alien. However, why is the purple lightning occurring, and what ties does it have to an old "friend"?

3.title: FR - Ben 10 (2005) - S03E12 - Be Afraid of the Dark
3.plot: Ghostfreak's return spells disaster for our heroes. Grandpa Max and Gwen must deal with the mummy alien in space while Ben deals with Ghostfreak and Dr. Vicktor on Earth. Ghostfreak then reveals his master plan: he plans to blanket the Earth with Coronium so that sunlight will not reach the planet so that he may rule. With the power of a new alien in the watch, can Ben stop Ghostfreak, and save Grandpa and Gwen?

3.title: FR - Ben 10 (2005) - S03E13 - The Visitor
3.plot: While snowmobiling, two guys accidentally release an alien named Xylene from a strange container. At a park, Ben (as Wildmutt) steals Gwen's kite, so she casts a spell to make dogs attracted to him. Grandpa Max seems sad to be in St. Louis since it is where he met his wife. Xylene attacks, and Grandpa Max comes to defend, only to recognize her. Xylene reveals that she came to find the Omnitrix since she lost it when Vilgax attacked her ship. While Grandpa Max and Xylene talk about the past, a robot emerges from the area where Xylene was and attacks Ben and Gwen. The mechadroid attacks twice, taking Grandpa Max with him. Now Ben must work with Xylene (to his dismay) to save Grandpa Max.

meta.plot: Benjamin Tennyson est un jeune garçon âgé de 10 ans rêvant de devenir un héros dans le but d'aider son prochain. En camping, pendant ses vacances scolaires avec sa cousine Gwen (intellectuelle et future magicienne) et son grand-père Max, il découvre, dans une capsule de sauvetage spatiale écrasée sur Terre, un objet en forme de montre aux pouvoirs étranges, appelée Omnitrix, qui se fixe tout seul à son poignet. Dorénavant il peut, tout en gardant sa personnalité d'enfant, se transformer en dix extraterrestres différents aux pouvoirs surhumains. Mais cet étrange bracelet est convoité par de terribles extra-terrestres déterminés, notamment un seigneur galactique nommé Vilgax. Ainsi, le garçon se doit désormais de lutter contre des menaces bien plus dangereuses que de simples voleurs.

1.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S01E01 - Turtle Tracks
1.plot: April O'Neil, ace reporter for Channel 6, investigates recent break-ins, allegedly by Ninjas, which have resulted in the thefts of numerous technologies. A chance encounter with a gang of thieves soon leads her to a bigger story when she is saved from the criminals by four Ninja trained, mutated Turtles.

1.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S01E02 - Enter: The Shredder
1.plot: The Shredder kidnaps Splinter in an attempt to lure the Turtles to his own cause. In order to rescue Splinter the Turtles must enter the Shredder's mobile fortress and brave it's dangerous weaponry.

1.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S01E03 - A Thing about Rats
1.plot: Baxter Stockman, a mad scientist, is showing an exterminator his new invention: a rat catching robot called Mousers.

1.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S01E04 - Hot Rodding Teenagers from Dimension X
1.plot: Shredder experiments with the Inter-Dimensional Portal, hoping to contact Krangs' Rock Soldiers and prepare an invasion of Earth, but a group of fun-loving aliens called the Neutrionos, renegades in Krang's dimension, take advantage of the Portal's opening and use it to arrive on Earth.

1.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S01E05 - Shredder & Splintered
1.plot: As Shredder lures Splinter into he Technodrome, this time with the promise that a weapon in his possession can restore the sensei to human form, the Turtles confront a giant-sized Krang, now in a new body, in the heart of New York City.

2.plot: Just when the Turtles believe themselves rid of Shredder, tin-grin is able to persuade Krang to return him to Earth.

2.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S02E02 - The Incredible Shrinking Turtles
2.plot: While practicing their martial arts in Central Park, the Turtles witness an alien spaceship crash into a small pond. The pilot warns them that they must find the three fragments of the Eye of Zarnof.

2.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S02E03 - It Came from Beneath the Sewers
2.plot: While the Turtles and April O'Neil scour the city for the Second Fragment of the Eye of Zarnov, Shredder sheepishly reports to Krang that he has lost the First Fragment.

2.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S02E04 - The Mean Machines
2.plot: After the batteries died in the alien crystal converger, Donatello, using spare circuits from the space ship, builds a tracking device to help locate the second fragment of the Eye of Zarnov.

2.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S02E05 - Curse of the Evil Eye
2.plot: The Turtles are still on the search for the last fragment. Shredder finds the last fragment and connects all three to his helmet.

2.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S02E06 - The Case of the Killer Pizzas
2.plot: Krang finally relents and provides Shredder with help in defeating the Turtles.

2.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S02E07 - Enter: The Fly
2.plot: Frustrated at Baxter's latest failure, Shredder contacts Krang in Dimension X and demands that Rocksteady and Bebop be sent to aid him.

2.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S02E08 - Invasion of the Punk Frogs
2.plot: Shredder plans to acquire more mutagen and create more mutants. An ion storm in Dimension X interferes with the dimensional portal.

2.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S02E09 - Splinter No More
2.plot: Sensing Master Splinter's despair at his new life as a rat, the Turtles agree to use the small amount of mutagen that they have left to concoct a formula that will revert Splinter back into Yoshi.

2.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S02E10 - New York's Shiniest
2.plot: Shredder learns that the police have created a robotic cop and plans to steal then clone it. April gets a tip about the new experimental cop Rex-1 and breaks into the lab with her news camera for an exclusive story.

2.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S02E11 - Teenagers from Dimension X
2.plot: While cruising around Dimension X, the Nutrinos decide to buzz the Technodrome. The Nutrinos learn of Krang & Shredder's latest plan to destroy the Turtles.

2.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S02E12 - The Cat Woman of Channel Six
2.plot: While experimenting with a matter transporter in his secret hideout, Shredder sends Rocksteady and Bebop to a nearby garbage dump. Through a series of mishaps, Rocksteady and Bebop find themselves in the Turtles' Lair.

2.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja (1987) - S02E13 - Return of the Technodrome
2.plot: Krang, sick of Shredder's constant failings, resolves to return the Technodrome to Earth.
