FR - Black Lagoon - S01E01 - The Black Lagoon
1.plot: Abducted by modern-day pirates and declared dead by his company, businessman Rokuro Okajima joins his captors on their ship, the Black Lagoon.

1.title: FR - Black Lagoon - S01E02 - Mangrove Heaven
1.plot: Rock devises a plan to destroy the gunship that seems to have trapped the Black Lagoon. Meanwhile, the Lagoon Company accepts Rock as a new member.

1.title: FR - Black Lagoon - S01E03 - Ring-Ding Ship Chase
1.plot: A gangster named Chin lures Dutch and the crew of the Black Lagoon into a battle at sea against Luak, the leader of rival pirates.

1.title: FR - Black Lagoon - S01E04 - Die Rückkehr des Adlers
1.plot: While on a mission to retrieve a valuable painting from a sunken U-boat, the Black Lagoon is besieged by missile-firing neo-Nazis.

1.title: FR - Black Lagoon - S01E05 - Eagle Hunting and Hunting Eagles
1.plot: After finding the painting on the sunken sub, Rock and Revy argue over looking for more loot while the neo-Nazis' own divers approach the wreck.

1.title: FR - Black Lagoon - S01E06 - Moonlit Hunting Grounds
1.plot: Dutch and Revy's violent raid on the neo-Nazi ship leads to surprising revelations about Revy and the Black Lagoon's mission to recover the painting.

1.title: FR - Black Lagoon - S01E07 - Calm Down, Two Men
1.plot: Revy's resentment at being sent on assignment with Rock may change when he calms a potentially volatile situation with a dealer.

1.title: FR - Black Lagoon - S01E08 - Rasta Blasta
1.plot: The Black Lagoon crew must deliver a young hostage to a Colombian cartel, but Dutch has a crisis of conscience when he learns the boy's identity.

1.title: FR - Black Lagoon - S01E09 - Maid to Kill
1.plot: The Black Lagoon crew discovers too late that Roberta is a formidable opponent with a price on her head, as they attempt to flee with Garcia.

1.title: FR - Black Lagoon - S01E10 - The Unstoppable Chambermaid
1.plot: Rock learns the truth about Balalaika's troops when they intervene in a no-holds-barred confrontation between Revy and Roberta.

1.title: FR - Black Lagoon - S01E11 - Lock 'n Load Revolution
1.plot: While transporting information on a terrorist organization to the CIA, the Black Lagoon crew comes under attack by the terrorists.

1.title: FR - Black Lagoon - S01E12 - Guerrillas in the Jungle
1.plot: Rock learns the truth about Takenaka while under interrogation, and gets an even bigger surprise after he's rescued by Revy and Shenhua.

1.title: FR - Black Lagoon - S01E13 - The Vampire Twins Comen
1.plot: A rash of killings targeting Hotel Moscow prompts a meeting of the major crime lords and suspicion falls on a pair of twin children.

1.title: FR - Black Lagoon - S01E14 - Bloodsport Fairytale
1.plot: After Rock and Chang trace the twins' origins to Romania, they become engaged in a deadly game of cat-and-mouse with the lethal kids.

1.title: FR - Black Lagoon - S01E15 - Swan Song at Dawn
1.plot: Gretel takes Eda hostage, demanding a getaway boat for herself and her brother. Meanwhile, Hansel holds off Balalaika's entire team alone.

1.title: FR - Black Lagoon - S01E16 - Greenback Jane
1.plot: The Florida mafia and various bounty hunters descend on the Church of Violence in pursuit of U.S. counterfeiter Greenback Jane, who wants to join.

1.title: FR - Black Lagoon - S01E17 - The Roanapur Freakshow Circus
1.plot: Eda tries to help Jane evade the bounty hunters, but her plans -- including an escape on the Black Lagoon -- are foiled at virtually every turn.

1.title: FR - Black Lagoon - S01E18 - Mr. Benny's Good Fortune
1.plot: Dutch and Benny attempt to rescue Jane and the others, and much will be revealed after the chase as they are pursued by the bounty hunters.

1.title: FR - Black Lagoon - S01E19 - Fujiyama Gangsta Paradise
1.plot: Rock and Revy accompany Balalaika to Japan, where they enact -- then endanger -- an assignment to take out one yakuza gang at the behest of another.

1.title: FR - Black Lagoon - S01E20 - The Succession
1.plot: Feuding breaks out between Balalaika and the Washimine gang, and Rock makes a shocking discovery about Yukio, the girl he met at the festival.

1.title: FR - Black Lagoon - S01E21 - Two Father's Little Soldier Girls
1.plot: Yukio is abducted on the day she takes control of the Washimine Group, and Rock pleads with Ginji to let him and Revy help rescue her.

1.title: FR - Black Lagoon - S01E22 - The Dark Tower
1.plot: Revy and Ginji try to save Yukio during a battle with Chaka and his men. Later, she takes Rock to task for trying to save her from a life of crime.

1.title: FR - Black Lagoon - S01E23 - Snow White's Payback
1.plot: Balalaika has wiped out much of the Washimine Group, but Yukio has learned something about Hotel Moscow's technique and uses it to her advantage.

1.title: FR - Black Lagoon - S01E24 - The Gunslingers
1.plot: Rock tries to force Yukio out of a life of crime, but events beyond his control may cause his well-laid plans for her future to spin out of control.

meta.plot: The story follows a team of pirate mercenaries known as the Lagoon Company, that smuggles goods in and around the seas of Southeast Asia in the early to mid 1990s. Their base of operations is located in the fictional harbor city of Roanapur in southeast Thailand near the border of Cambodia.

1.title: FR - Être Parent - S01E01 - The Greatest Adventure
1.plot: A journey like no other – full of moments of joy and danger. For animal parents in the wild, the stakes could not be higher, with success ensuring the future of life on our planet.

1.title: FR - Être Parent - S01E02 - Oceans
1.plot: Parenting in the ocean is rare, and demands dedication and intelligence. From navigating the reef, to teaching their young to hunt giants, these parents have the most remarkable strategies on Earth.

1.title: FR - Être Parent - S01E03 - Grasslands
1.plot: Parents must constantly balance risk and reward when raising young in open grasslands. Whilst abundant grass promises plentiful food and places to call home, this alone cannot guarantee success.

1.title: FR - Être Parent - S01E04 - Freshwater
1.plot: Water is essential to all life on Earth but too much or too little can be disastrous. Parents must master timing, to overcome freshwater’s constant change and successfully raise the next generation.

1.title: FR - Être Parent - S01E05 - Jungles
1.plot: Raising young in the complex world of jungles requires ingenuity. Parents must become masters of their environment and learn to exploit every opportunity through determination and teamwork.

meta.plot: Un parcours unique, plein de risques et de récompenses. David Attenborough raconte des histoires de dévouement, d'ingéniosité et de sacrifice alors que les animaux se lancent dans un défi épique : devenir parents.

1.title: FR - How to Ruin Love - S01E01 - Love Fool
1.plot: Just days before their anniversary, Zoleka starts to believe that her boyfriend Kagiso is having an affair with her bestie Amahle.

1.title: FR - How to Ruin Love - S01E02 - Chasing Love Backs
1.plot: A viral video of Zoleka's outburst puts her acting career in jeopardy and costs Kagiso an app sale worth millions, threatening his family home.

1.title: FR - How to Ruin Love - S01E03 - Maybe Love Is Not Enough
1.plot: After getting back in Amahle's good graces, Zoleka proposes a daring plan to Kagiso. Aunt Doreen takes ownership of Papi's home.

1.title: FR - How to Ruin Love - S01E04 - All You Need Is Love
1.plot: When her insecurities get the better of her again, Zoleka loses sight of her happy ending.

meta.plot: Soupçonnant son petit ami de lui être infidèle, Zoleka essaie de le prendre sur le fait... et gâche sa demande en mariage. Maintenant, elle va devoir le reconquérir.

1.title: FR - Sandokan [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - The Malaysian Tiger
1.plot: Sandokan and his crew board a ship and free a captive, who is convinced the pirate is the warrior from an old prophecy. Landing in Labuan in disguise, Sandokan meets Marianne, the consul's daughter and clashes with Brooke, a pirate hunter.

1.title: FR - Sandokan [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - The Pearl of Labuan
1.plot: Marianne is celebrating her twenty-first birthday. Sandokan and Brooke are invited to the ball. Tension builds between the three, but Sandokan must first free Yanez and his crew, imprisoned in the dungeons, and try not to blow his cover.

meta.plot: Sandokan is a Malaysian pirate who, along with his friend Yanez and their crew, attacks the British forces from his island of Mompracem. During his adventures, he falls in love with Lady Marianna Guillonk, an English-Italian aristocrat.

1.title: FR - Tour de France : Au cœur du peloton - S01E01 - The Grand Départ
1.plot: With mere days to go, Quick-Step Alpha Vinyl announces their lineup and assesses the odds against them. Can Fabio Jakobsen sprint his way to a comeback?

1.title: FR - Tour de France : Au cœur du peloton - S01E02 - Welcome to Hell
1.plot: Stacked with fierce riders, team Jumbo-Visma takes on the cobblestones — but mechanical challenges and internal competition make for a chaotic stage.

1.title: FR - Tour de France : Au cœur du peloton - S01E03 - The Weight of a Nation
1.plot: A third of the way into the race with no wins for France, Groupama-FDJ and AG2R-Citroën enter the mountain stage with the eyes of a nation upon them.

1.title: FR - Tour de France : Au cœur du peloton - S01E04 - Attack, Counter Attack
1.plot: During the Granon stage, Jonas makes a bid for the yellow jersey — but when a swift Slovenian gets in his way, Jumbo-Visma changes their plan of attack.

1.title: FR - Tour de France : Au cœur du peloton - S01E05 - Breakneck Speed
1.plot: As EF Education-EasyPost strategically showcase their young talent, the INEOS Grenadiers consider using their secret weapon: newcomer Thomas Pidcock.

1.title: FR - Tour de France : Au cœur du peloton - S01E06 - Plan B
1.plot: When their leader drops out, Alpecin-Deceuninck hedges their bets on Jasper "Disaster" Philipsen. Will he live up to his nickname or redeem himself?

1.title: FR - Tour de France : Au cœur du peloton - S01E07 - Everything for the Podium
1.plot: The last week of the tour arrives. With his legacy on the line, 2018 winner Geraint Thomas battles Groupama-FDJ leader David Gaudu for a podium spot.

1.title: FR - Tour de France : Au cœur du peloton - S01E08 - Road to Paris
1.plot: A final push in the mountains remains between the sprinters and Paris. While Fabio finds his fire, Jonas and Wout fight Tadej Pogačar to the finish.

meta.plot: Des larmes aux victoires, cette série suit plusieurs équipes qui s'affrontent durant l'édition 2022 de la plus grande course cycliste du monde.

meta.plot: Pour la première fois, Jessica et Thibault, Manon et Julien, Laura et Nikola, Maeva, Paga et Giuseppa, Greg, Océane et Marine se livrent sans filtre et sans tabou. Vos stars de séries-réalité préférées ont accepté de nous ouvrir leurs portes et de nous faire partager les moments les plus intimes de leur vie de famille.

1.title: FR - The Narrow Road to the Deep North - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: While writing a speech for an upcoming book launch, renowned surgeon and celebrated war hero, Dorrigo Evans is thrust back into memories of his time as a POW in WW2 and of his brief, yet unforgettable, love affair with Amy Mulvaney. A love which sustained him through this dark time.

1.title: FR - The Narrow Road to the Deep North - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: We witness the burgeoning love affair between Dorrigo and Amy in the 1940s, which is in stark contrast to his present day marriage to his wife, Ella. The banality of his current life in the 1980s leads Dorrigo to take a risk that puts his surgical career in jeopardy.

1.title: FR - The Narrow Road to the Deep North - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Dorrigo has come under investigation for a risky procedure he performed, placing a further strain on his marriage. A marriage that is already feeling the effects of Dorrigo's everlasting love for Amy, a love both cannot resist. We also witness Dorrigo's deep love and care towards the soldiers when a cholera outbreak spreads through the POW camp, and his friend Rabbit becomes increasingly unwell.

1.title: FR - The Narrow Road to the Deep North - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Dorrigo and Amy's affair must end when Dorrigo is shipped off to war, where as a prisoner he bares witness to the most horrific of crimes.

1.title: FR - The Narrow Road to the Deep North - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Dorrigo returns from war and tries to get on with his life without Amy and many of his friends he lost to the POW camp. While in the present, the day of the book launch arrives and Dorrigo's reflections on his life come to a head.

meta.plot: En 1989, en Australie, Dorrigo Evans, chirurgien renommé et héros de guerre, se prépare à prononcer un discours lors de la sortie d’un ouvrage consacré à la Seconde Guerre mondiale. Cet événement ravive les souvenirs de son passé : en 1943, alors qu’il était médecin militaire fait prisonnier par les Japonais, il fut contraint de travailler sur la ligne de chemin de fer reliant la Thaïlande à la Birmanie. Dans l’enfer de la jungle, entre violence, maladie et perte, il trouva la force de survivre grâce au souvenir de son amour interdit avec Amy Mulvaney, la femme de son oncle.

1.title: FR - Pro Bono [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Kang Da-wit's rise as a judge comes to a crashing halt after a scandal. A far less glamorous opportunity offers him an unexpected new start.

1.title: FR - Pro Bono [VOSTFR] - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: A shocking discovery complicates Eliyah's case, prompting the pro bono team to challenge her contract — even as public opinion turns against her.

1.title: FR - Pro Bono [VOSTFR] - S01E09 - Episode 9
1.plot: After the pro bono team narrowly avoids being shut down, a shadowy figure approaches Park Gi-ppeum — asking her to file a lawsuit against Da-wit.

1.title: FR - Pro Bono [VOSTFR] - S01E10 - Episode 10
1.plot: Da-wit stands trial as a defendant, facing the very team he has mentored. Meanwhile, both sides hunt for the truth that could bring light to the turmoil.

FR - Un jour, peut-être - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: After Jiwoo's divorce story breaks, Kyeong-do becomes caught up in a scandal himself. With help from his friends, he manages to publish a rebuttal article. However, at the request of Ji-woo's older sister, Ji-yeon, he ends up getting involved with Ji-woo once again.

1.title: FR - Un jour, peut-être - S01E03 - Episode 3
FR - Un jour, peut-être - S01E04 - Episode 4

1.plot: Jin-eon steps back in response to Kyeong-do's flirting. Kyeong-do then settles into Ji-woo's home, insisting he will stay close and take care of her alcoholism.

1.title: FR - Un jour, peut-être - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Kyeong-do ultimately gives up his training program in Chicago. Meanwhile, Ji-woo learns the secret between Ji-yeon and Kyeong-do. Now Ji-woo must decide what to do.

1.title: FR - Un jour, peut-être - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: The two finally confirm their feelings for each other. However, Jin-eon still seems to have lingering feelings for Ji-woo. Meanwhile, Kyeong-do hears a shocking story about Min-woo from Ji-yeon.

1.title: FR - Un jour, peut-être - S01E08 - Episode 8
FR - Un jour, peut-être - S01E09 - Episode 9
FR - Un jour, peut-être - S01E10 - Episode 10

meta.plot: Dans la vingtaine, Lee Kyeong-do et Seo-Ji-woo se séparent après une relation passionnelle. Dix ans plus tard, ils se retrouvent, l'un comme journaliste sur un scandale d'infidélité, l'autre comme épouse de l'homme impliqué. La candeur de la jeunesse s'est certes estompée, mais leur amour ne s'est jamais éteint. Kyeong-do tient à prouver, à elle et à lui-même, que son amour demeure inchangé.

1.title: FR - L'essor de l'Empire ottoman - S01E01 - The New Sultan
1.plot: After claiming the Ottoman throne, Mehmed II sends an unmistakable signal to Byzantine emperor Constantine XI. Enter Genoese mercenaries.

1.title: FR - L'essor de l'Empire ottoman - S01E02 - Through The Walls
1.plot: Mehmed launches an ambitious siege to break through the walls of Constantinople, but Giustiniani's mercenaries manage to forestall the Janissaries.

1.title: FR - L'essor de l'Empire ottoman - S01E03 - Into The Golden Horn
1.plot: Mehmed's men dig underground tunnels in an attempt to shatter city walls. The tides turn against the Ottomans when a naval blockade founders.

1.title: FR - L'essor de l'Empire ottoman - S01E04 - Loose Lips Sink Ships
1.plot: Mehmed moves his ships overland to the Golden Horn in a daring, visionary feat. In the shadow of betrayal, Giustiniani attacks the Ottoman fleet.

1.title: FR - L'essor de l'Empire ottoman - S01E05 - Ancient Prophecies
1.plot: Amid a spiral of brutality and low morale, Mehmed makes Giustiniani an enticing offer. The grand vizier urges Mehmed to seek a truce with his rival.

1.title: FR - L'essor de l'Empire ottoman - S01E06 - Ashes to Ashes
1.plot: Ottoman cannons reduce the city walls to rubble, and Venetian reinforcements arrive too late. Mehmed ushers in a new era for the Ottoman Empire.

2.title: FR - L'essor de l'Empire ottoman - S02E01 - House Of War
2.plot: Mehmed II solidifies his reign, but in nearby Wallachia, childhood friend Vlad the Impaler gains notoriety and seeks to challenge Mehmed's hegemony.

2.title: FR - L'essor de l'Empire ottoman - S02E02 - Troubled Waters
2.plot: Mehmed sends Maria to coax Hungarian King Matthias Corvinus into an alliance. An epic battle along the Danube River looms, and Vlad has the upper hand.

2.title: FR - L'essor de l'Empire ottoman - S02E03 - Land Of Dracula
2.plot: Mehmed's troops advance into Wallachia, and Vlad employs guerrilla tactics to weaken his rival. A threat lurks in the imperial palace.

2.title: FR - L'essor de l'Empire ottoman - S02E04 - Brothers No More
2.plot:
4. Brothers No More

As the war drags on and resources dwindle, Vlad wages biological warfare on Mehmed's army. Radu closes in on Vlad's castle to take Anastasia hostage.

2.title: FR - L'essor de l'Empire ottoman - S02E05 - Night Attack
2.plot: Mehmed prepares to strike a fatal blow to Vlad's army. A spy is found in Mehmed's camp. Vlad launches a nighttime attack, but a surprise awaits.

2.title: FR - L'essor de l'Empire ottoman - S02E06 - Destiny
2.plot: Vlad and Mehmed face off. Maria and Gülbahar foil the Wallachian plot. Ottoman troops march into an abandoned Târgoviște and face a gruesome sight.

meta.plot: Le sultan ottoman Mehmed II mène une campagne épique pour s'emparer de la capitale byzantine de Constantinople et façonne le cours de l'Histoire pour les siècles à venir.

1.plot: Two parolees slog through pest control jobs to make ends meet. But Manca's health concerns and mounting bills leave Inés desperate for a better option.

1.title: FR - Le Temps des mouches - S01E02 - The Price of Poison
1.plot: After learning the cost of Manca's biopsy, Inés weighs a risky but lucrative offer from Susana Bonar — a wealthy client who won't take no for an answer.

1.title: FR - Le Temps des mouches - S01E03 - Life Goes On
1.plot: Before prison, Inés hosts a lavish birthday dinner for her husband Ernesto, where family insults and parenting spats push her composure to the brink.

1.title: FR - Le Temps des mouches - S01E04 - Stop Digging
1.plot: As Bonar's erratic behavior raises red flags, Manca and Rody dig into her past. Inés rushes to gather lethal supplies after Bonar tightens the deadline.

1.title: FR - Le Temps des mouches - S01E05 - The Point of No Return
1.plot: A tragic memory reveals the source of Bonar's grief. Manca and Rody trace her ties to Inés as shady suppliers put her at risk during a pesticide pickup.

1.title: FR - Le Temps des mouches - S01E06 - Time Flies
1.plot: While Manca undergoes surgery, Inés learns of Bonar's macabre plan — and must act fast when those she loves most appear to be in danger.

meta.plot: À peine sorties de prison et sans options, deux femmes gèrent une société de désinfection, jusqu'à ce qu'une cliente louche les ramène à la vie qu'elles espéraient tant fuir.

1.title: FR - Street Food: USA - S01E01 - Los Angeles, California
1.plot: Carnitas simmered with love, skewers kissed by fire, hot dogs that make the score — some of the best eats in LA can be found in its many communities.

1.title: FR - Street Food: USA - S01E02 - Portland, Oregon
1.plot: Portland's freethinking food scene fosters barbecue brisket tacos, loaded mac and cheese — and Thuy Pham's heartfelt Vietnamese vegan pork belly.

1.title: FR - Street Food: USA - S01E03 - New York, New York
1.plot: Always on the go, the Big Apple fuels its hustle with soul-stirring shrimp and grits, crisp slices, spicy halal chicken and rice, and snappy dogs.

1.title: FR - Street Food: USA - S01E04 - New Orlean, Louisiana
1.plot: Amid a party city's mix of po'boys, snoballs and crawfish, Ms. Linda Green's beloved yakamein bubbles with inspiration, even in the face of tragedy.

1.title: FR - Street Food: USA - S01E05 - Oahu, Hawaii
1.plot: Sparkling fresh poke. Succulent kalua pig. Tempting, tender kalbi. For a real taste of Hawaii, take a bite at its lunch trucks and holes-in-the-wall.

1.title: FR - Street Food: USA - S01E06 - Miami, Florida
1.plot: Souse — that bold, vinegary broth boosted with meat and potatoes — saved Souseman Larry's life in a town built on fritas, pikliz and Cuban sandwiches.

meta.plot: Découvrez les saveurs uniques de la cuisine de rue des États-Unis et la diversité des personnes qui se consacrent corps et âme à leurs recettes.

1.title: FR - HIS & HERS - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: TV newswoman Anna returns to her small Georgia hometown to report on a murder case, in which her estranged husband Jack is the lead investigator.

1.title: FR - HIS & HERS - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Jack and Priya try to poke holes in a key suspect's alibi. Anna returns to her alma mater for a contentious interview with an old classmate.

1.title: FR - HIS & HERS - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Anna jumps at a chance to return to the anchor desk. Zoe confronts Jack about what he's been hiding. Alice's decline forces some tough conversations.

1.title: FR - HIS & HERS - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Jack struggles to placate the locals at a fiery town hall. Priya's suspicions reach a breaking point. Anna is haunted by painful memories.

1.title: FR - HIS & HERS - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Backed into a corner, Jack grows increasingly erratic. Anna finds herself on the opposite side of an interview. Richard's past comes to light.

1.title: FR - HIS & HERS - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: As the case comes to a close, Jack and Anna must reckon with the sins of the past — and the brutal consequences in the present.

meta.plot: Dans la chaleur étouffante d'Atlanta, Anna vit dans une solitude obsédante, s'éloignant de ses amis et de sa carrière de journaliste. Mais lorsqu'elle entend parler d'un meurtre à Dahlonega, la ville paisible où elle a grandi, elle revient à la vie et se jette sur l'affaire en quête de réponses. Le détective Jack Harper n'apprécie guère son implication et se méfie...

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Talented songwriter Yeimy plots revenge against those who put her in prison. She recalls her high school crush Charly, who's now a famous singer.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Teenage Yeimy mourns her loss. Soul and Bass raise money by putting on their first concert. To prove himself to his uncle, Charly accepts a risky job.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: After Yeimy confronts Charly about what he's done, he takes advantage of her feelings for him, and comes up with a plan so his uncle won't kill her.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: When Juancho refuses to believe Yeimy is guilty, Charly tries to convince him otherwise. In prison, Yeimy receives a threat, followed by shocking news.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: After visiting Yeimy in the U.S., her grandmother returns home to a nasty surprise. Years later, Charly wonders about his adopted brother's parentage.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Juancho mourns Yeimy's supposed death as she arrives in Puerto Rico and begins training for her undercover work as music producer Tamy.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Her training complete, Yeimy returns to Medellín for the first time in 17 years and finally comes face to face with Charly. Erik enters a music battle.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Yeimy reunites with an unsuspecting Juancho. Vanesa gets approached by a talent scout for modeling. Charly tries to win over a critical reporter.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E09 - Episode 9
1.plot: Yeimy attends the next "cockfight" to find new talent. Charly performs a concert with reggaeton star Sebastián Yatra and debuts Yeimy's new song.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E10 - Episode 10
1.plot: The modeling agent pressures Vanesa to expand her personal boundaries. Yeimy brings a young new singer to Charly, and later tries to bug his office.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E11 - Episode 11
1.plot: Vanesa tells her parents about her new job. Erik runs away from home after a fight with Charly. Juancho is forced to work for Excelsior Studios.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E12 - Episode 12
1.plot: Erik looks for answers about his birth parents. Yeimy and Juancho collaborate to produce Cris's first track. Gema suspects Charly is still seeing Zulma.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E13 - Episode 13
1.plot: Yeimy releases an incriminating video of Charly and Zulma, but in trying to ruin his career, she also ends up impacting his daughter, Vanesa.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E14 - Episode 14
1.plot: Erik gets an anonymous offer that spurs him to secretly record an album with Yeimy and Juancho. Charly works on repairing his image and relationships.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E15 - Episode 15
1.plot: When the DEA goes after Manín, Charly gets caught in the crossfire. Yeimy tries to get Vanesa to open up to her, and gives Gema PR advice.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E16 - Episode 16
1.plot: Erik finds out the name of his birth mother. Yeimy tries to get closer to Gema. Charly returns home and is determined to find the mole.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E17 - Episode 17
1.plot: Charly tasks Axl with reviewing the security footage. Lucio follows Carrancho to a phone booth. Cata's growing suspicions about Yeimy annoy Juancho.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E18 - Episode 18
1.plot: Erik meets the informant's go-between at the park. Ligia reaches her limit with Manín. Juancho and Yeimy fight over her relationship with Charly.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E19 - Episode 19
1.plot: Erik learns who his informant was. Gema seeks another man's attentions. Charly pays a surprise visit to Yeimy's home. Vanesa and Silvana go to a party.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E20 - Episode 20
1.plot: The accident has devastating repercussions. Yeimy spots an opportunity and calls Silvana's father. Jack declares to Yeimy his feelings for her.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E21 - Episode 21
1.plot: Yeimy makes a comment that leads Juancho to doubt her identity. Vanesa becomes distraught when she hears Silvana's father speak to the press on TV.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E22 - Episode 22
1.plot: Gema searches Vanesa's room to see if she's lying about using drugs only once. Juancho contacts the musicians shown in photos with Yeimy on her website.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E23 - Episode 23
1.plot: Juancho confronts Yeimy with his suspicions about who she really is. Vanesa argues with her parents after they reveal their plans for her.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E24 - Episode 24
1.plot: Juancho argues with Yeimy about her vengefulness. Charly grows suspicious of Yeimy and Juancho and has her followed. Vanesa's family goes to therapy.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E25 - Episode 25
1.plot: Charly pays a visit to the modeling agency. Yeimy calls reporter Zulma and asks to meet in private. Drug dealer Ruko reconnects with Vanesa.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E26 - Episode 26
1.plot: Erik's single debuts on the radio. Yeimy finds a way to get Charly to ask his uncle for a favor that could reveal Manín's location.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E27 - Episode 27
1.plot: When Erik's single surpasses Cris Vega's, Charly starts to ask about Pez Koi and ends up in a fight with Juancho. Gema visits Triana and gets a shock.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E28 - Episode 28
1.plot: Falcioni realizes he's being followed. Unable to reach Yeimy, Charly sinks into despair. Erik celebrates his hit single with his friends and family.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E29 - Episode 29
1.plot: Falcioni signs a deal with the DEA. At a press conference, Erik reveals he's Pez Koi. After telling Yeimy about her affair, Gema gets an anonymous text.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E30 - Episode 30
1.plot: Charly flips out once he learns Pez Koi's real identity, but his mother intervenes. Cata follows her suspicions. Yeimy and Zulma plot their next move.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E31 - Episode 31
1.plot: Manín orders his thugs to do whatever it takes to get Charly to bring him cash. Vanesa gets in trouble with the law. Cata continues her investigations.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E32 - Episode 32
1.plot: Manín's men make a discovery about Yeimy. Gema and Charly are forced to take a painful step regarding Vanesa. Cata confronts Juancho with her findings.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E33 - Episode 33
1.plot: Vanesa grudgingly starts rehab. As Yeimy takes her relationship with Charly to the next level, Juancho worries about her. Manín's men go after Ligia.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E34 - Episode 34
1.plot: Juancho and Yeimy argue over how far she'll go to get info from Charly. A photo makes Manín suspicious of Charly. Vanesa sees a familiar face at rehab.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E35 - Episode 35
1.plot: When Erik calls Manín on the phone Yeimy gave him, the DEA traces the call to the criminal's exact location and launches an operation to capture him.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E36 - Episode 36
1.plot: In rehab, new friend Pau shows Vanesa a healthier way to escape her problems. Cata is shocked by a revelation on her wedding day.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E37 - Episode 37
1.plot: Gema harbors doubts about her separation. Cata has a few too many drinks and gives an emotional speech. Yeimy decides to continue living undercover.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E38 - Episode 38
1.plot: Yeimy feeds Zulma her next news story. Charly and Juancho get heated while negotiating the terms of an upcoming concert. Erik visits Vanesa in rehab.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E39 - Episode 39
1.plot: Yeimy, Gema and Charly decide to change the venue of the concert. Erik and Irma's connection grows stronger. Vanesa runs away from rehab.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E40 - Episode 40
1.plot: Yeimy feels conflicted after Vanesa asks for a favor. Cata confides in her mom about Juancho. Charly gets involved again with Manín's business.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E41 - Episode 41
1.plot: Cris Vega gets a nasty surprise. Erik and Charly rehearse before their big concert. Yeimy helps Gema find a PI to investigate her husband's activities.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E42 - Episode 42
1.plot: Yeimy persuades Vanesa to speak to her dad. On the day of the concert, Irma helps Erik with his nerves, and Charly arrives at the venue to a surprise.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E43 - Episode 43
1.plot: Vanesa brings Ruko to visit her dad backstage before the show. Axl catches Juancho letting teens in through a back door. Erik invites a guest onstage.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E44 - Episode 44
1.plot: When the concert's final performance is sabotaged, Erik scrambles to recover. Vanesa overhears her parents talking about Ruko. Gema's PI follows Charly.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E45 - Episode 45
1.plot: Cata decides to keep closer tabs on Juancho. The PI's photos rattle Yeimy. Vanesa finds Ruko's drugs. Zulma posts her interview with Cris Vega.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E46 - Episode 46
1.plot: Yeimy overhears Charly and Gema's amicable divorce negotiations and leaps into action. A suitor visits Vanesa. Erik asks Irma to be his girlfriend.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E47 - Episode 47
1.plot: Juancho asks Yeimy if she's still in love with Charly, and can no longer contain his own feelings. While out with friends, Vanesa runs into Ruko.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E48 - Episode 48
1.plot: Irma signs with a label. The PI snaps photos of Charly conducting his shady side business. Cata's mom tells her how to fill the void in her marriage.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E49 - Episode 49
1.plot: Cata secretly takes her mom's latest advice. Erik shares a detail about his birth mom that stuns Juancho. Charly blackmails Gema to get what he wants.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E50 - Episode 50
1.plot: Juancho helps Yeimy process his news. Charly investigates the car following him. Gema goes on a date, and later tries to gather evidence against Charly.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E51 - Episode 51
1.plot: Juancho tries to dissuade Erik from asking Charly about Yeimy Montoya. Yeimy requests a DNA test. Gema gets the ammunition she needs to fight Charly.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E52 - Episode 52
1.plot: Vanesa has a difficult talk with Pite. Lucio captures the PI. Cata catches Juancho lying again. Yeimy makes a change in her relationship with Charly.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E53 - Episode 53
1.plot: Charly gets bad news from Don Edgar. Yeimy helps Vanesa with Ruko. When Gema shows Charlie her evidence against him, he realizes he needs to stop her.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E54 - Episode 54
1.plot: Charly asks Lucio for a favor. Yeimy baits Ruko with the help of the DEA. Cata pressures Juancho into signing more artists, including Cris Vega.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E55 - Episode 55
1.plot: After learning Gema will be working late at the studio, Charly calls Lucio. When Vanesa changes Gema's mind about Charly, Yeimy plays her last card.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E56 - Episode 56
1.plot: Yeimy asks Zulma to record her testimony on video. Pite offers Vanesa advice based on his own experience. Juancho follows Charly to see who he meets.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E57 - Episode 57
1.plot: Erik questions Charly's version of events. Gema's new boyfriend crashes a church service. Yeimy asks Juancho to pick up the DNA test results.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E58 - Episode 58
1.plot: Axl looks through Excelsior's security footage. Zulma posts the video of Yeimy telling her side of the story. Cris Vega auditions for Juancho.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E59 - Episode 59
1.plot: As Juancho's marital doubts increase, Cata spends more time with Cris. The police get forensic test results back. Erik and Yeimy collaborate on a song.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E60 - Episode 60
1.plot: In light of the DNA evidence, Charly scrambles to cover his tracks. Pite tries to cheer up Vanesa. Juancho learns of Cata's efforts to get pregnant.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E61 - Episode 61
1.plot: Erik follows Irma home and is shocked by what he discovers. Pite makes a confession to Vanesa. Over drinks, Cris gets Cata to confide in him.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E62 - Episode 62
1.plot: The police go after Yeimy, who has to decide whether to flee or turn herself in. Erik finds out how the police learned where Yeimy was hiding.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E63 - Episode 63
1.plot: Juancho reveals Yeimy's true identity to the police. Cata shares surprising news with Juancho. Charly convinces the police to let him talk to Yeimy.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E64 - Episode 64
1.plot: Axl shows Charly a new track he created. After hearing Juancho's news, Yeimy receives a surprise visitor. Charly coaches Irma to perform seductively.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E65 - Episode 65
1.plot: Vanesa confronts Yeimy. The ballistic report comes back. Yeimy is warned she's going to be attacked that day. Zulma launches a campaign to free Yeimy.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E66 - Episode 66
1.plot: Vanesa senses her father is hiding something from her and searches his bedroom. The police get a warrant to arrest Charly's shady accountant.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E67 - Episode 67
1.plot: After being visited by Jack and Juancho, Yeimy makes a big decision. Axl fumes over creative differences with Charly. Irma gets fed up with her dad.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E68 - Episode 68
1.plot: Yeimy finally divulges her identity to Charly. Lucio gives his girlfriend an item for safekeeping. Vanesa introduces Pite to her father.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E69 - Episode 69
1.plot: Yeimy tells Erik who his birth mom is and tries to answer all his questions. The police close in on Lucio. Ligia learns the truth about Erik's origins.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E70 - Episode 70
1.plot: Erik reveals who his birth father is to Charly. Cata pays a surprise visit to Yeimy's home. The police call an anonymous number listed on Lucio's phone.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E71 - Episode 71
1.plot: Yeimy agrees to work for Surround on one condition, and later reveals a new secret online. When Mora gets greedy, Charly's lawyer comes up with a plan.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E72 - Episode 72
1.plot: Misfortune puts Cata in the wrong place at the wrong time. Axl suspects Charly is stealing his song. Lucio's girlfriend discovers what's on the phone.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E73 - Episode 73
1.plot: Juancho makes a decision about Cata. Lucio's girlfriend pays Charly a visit. Irma discovers who her father injured. Yeimy arranges to meet with Axl.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E74 - Episode 74
1.plot: The police help Yeimy get a visit with Mora. Charly meets Lucio's girlfriend to pay her off. Irma tells her father what she learned about his victim.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E75 - Episode 75
1.plot: Axl auditions for Yeimy. Ligia visits Irma's father. Erik and Cris's social media contest begins. Irma tries to dispel rumors about her and Charly.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E76 - Episode 76
1.plot: Rosalía ardently pursues Juancho. Mora asks to speak to Detective Contreras and Yeimy. The man who unlocked the phone for Marlene goes to the police.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E77 - Episode 77
1.plot: Rosalía tries to create distance between Juancho and Yeimy. Irma's father, José, visits Ligia. Yeimy seeks Axl's help in proving Charly's guilt.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E78 - Episode 78
1.plot: Yeimy arranges to meet Marlene's friend who unlocked the phone. A fan asks Erik a delicate question. Juancho decides to wait no longer to pursue Yeimy.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E79 - Episode 79
1.plot: José attends his job interview. After Vanesa hears the recording, Yeimy is forced to tell her harsh truths. Juancho learns Rosalía tried to buy votes.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E80 - Episode 80
1.plot: Vanesa's loved ones urge her to give the police what she found in the closet. Yeimy has a tough talk with Jack. Cata makes an announcement to Juancho.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E81 - Episode 81
1.plot: Charly confronts Axl, who has a change of mind. During his concert, Erik invites his dad to join him onstage. The recording analysis results come back.

1.title: FR - La Reine du flow - S01E82 - Episode 82
1.plot: When Vanesa gets a call from her father, she makes a confession to him. Charly plays his last hand. Two years later, everyone's fates are revealed.

FR - Tomodachi Game - S01E01 - Huh? Yuichi-kun Suspects His Friends?
1.plot: After the hard-earned funds for their expensive high school class trip are stolen, sophomore Yuichi and his four best friends are kidnapped by Manabu, a surreal character from a creepy late-night anime show. The mischievous Manabu challenges the students to a series of mind games that the five must decipher and outwit in order to win back their trip funds, uncover the thief, and pay off a huge and mysterious debt.

1.title: FR - Tomodachi Game - S01E02 - You Have a Lot to Say to Me, Don't You?
1.plot: Yuichi and friends reach the end of Kokkuri-san, uncovering dimensions of trickery in the Tomodachi Game that they hadn't imagined. When they move on to a second game, a socially destructive version of sugoroku, the group struggles to maintain balance as personal secrets are revealed and trust is stretched to its absolute limit.

1.title: FR - Tomodachi Game - S01E03 - There's No Way I'd Believe That
1.plot: Dark secrets are exposed as the second game, Bad-Mouth Sugoroku, continues. Yutori is devastated when a traumatic episode from her past is revealed, leading her to suspect the only other person who knew—Shiho. As debts increase, the five friends are driven further apart. With no one else to turn to, Yutori clings to Yuichi for help, and Yuichi pledges his support.

1.title: FR - Tomodachi Game - S01E04 - Seriously? That's So Cringe
1.plot: Responsible for the theft of the class funds, the application to play Tomodachi Game, and the exposure of all kinds of dirty secrets in Bad-Mouth Sugoroku, Tenji now tries to alienate Shiho from the others so he can have her all to himself. As a result of his attempts, a rift develops between Shiho and Yutori that threatens to destroy their friendship. But while Tenji is busy sweet-talking Shiho and planning his next move, a "special chance" appears for Shiho that might change the direction of the game.

1.title: FR - Tomodachi Game - S01E05 - Yuichi-kun, You're Pretty Dumb, Aren't You?
1.plot: Shibe reels from the accusation that he has "actually killed a person." Despite protesting that he never did such a thing, he loses the audience's confidence and is thrust into first place. Meanwhile, Tenji finds himself in a distressing situation after realizing Yuichi is the one who wrote the card. Yuichi then makes the shocking announcement that he knows who the traitor is.

1.title: FR - Tomodachi Game - S01E06 - I Really Can't Be Friends with a "Murderer"
1.plot: Backed into a corner by Yuichi's plan, Tenji is forced to confess that he applied to play Tomodachi Game. Yuichi spells out the traps he set to smoke out the traitor and reveals that he had been manipulating the game from the start. The second game then reaches a breathtakingly unexpected conclusion.

1.title: FR - Tomodachi Game - S01E07 - I'll Take 20 Million Yen Worth of Your Life
1.plot: After clearing Bad-Mouth Sugoroku, Yuichi and Tenji find themselves trapped in a dark cave for three days. During their isolation, Tenji makes the shocking revelation that he had already experienced a Tomodachi Game in the past. Meanwhile, a team of new opponents lies in wait outside, anxious to challenge the two partners to a grueling third game.

1.title: FR - Tomodachi Game - S01E08 - It's a Game Where You Wait, and Wait, and Wait...and Keep Waiting
1.plot: The third game, Friendly Hide-and-Seek, begins. Rival Group K, bolstered by an apparent 'genius' strategist, proceeds with a clear numerical advantage. Eager to regain Yuichi's trust, Tenji volunteers to be Group C's hider, but the couple's plans are strained by the addition of a new female teammate, Mizuse Maria. Yuichi confidently tells Tenji to "just trust me and wait," but then doesn't return for days...

1.title: FR - Tomodachi Game - S01E09 - Hurry Up and "Switch Sides"
1.plot: Yuichi, who hasn’t left the starting point in the two days since the game began, suddenly announces his desire to switch to Group K. The Group K members, puzzled by Yuichi’s apparent intention to abandon his hiding teammate, ask their Captain to decide whether or not to let Yuichi in. Meanwhile, Tenji, who has stayed in hiding and trusted Yuichi all along, is finally reaching his physical breaking point.

1.title: FR - Tomodachi Game - S01E10 - The Third Game Is Over!
1.plot: Finally able to shake his Group K guards, Yuichi succeeds in delivering food to Tenji. After being pushed off the cliff by Yuichi, Maria slowly gets closer to her saviors Hyakutaro and Chisato, but that too is a trap set by Yuichi to destroy the friendships in Group K.

1.title: FR - Tomodachi Game - S01E11 - Do You Really Have Noting You Care About?
1.plot: With "true genius" Kei controlling things from the shadows, Group K succeeds in finding Tenji. Facing the "worst thing that could have happened," Tenji makes a phone call to a certain individual. The third game, Friendly Hide-and-Seek, then reaches its conclusion. While the two groups struggled to outwit each other, Shiho, Shibe, and Yutori, who had been temporarily released for the third game, returned to school only to be met with cold stares from their classmates.

1.title: FR - Tomodachi Game - S01E12 - What's Most Important to Me Is...
1.plot: Yuuichi goes to help Kokorogi knowing it will be very dangerous, but things could turn out worse than imagined.

meta.plot: Le lycéen Yuichi Katagiri place l’amitié au-dessus de tout ! Il a une vie épanouie avec ses amis Shiho Sawaragi, Tenji Mikasa, Makoto Shibe et Yutori Kokorogi. Cependant, un incident les entraîne dans un jeu dans lequel ils doivent rembourser une énorme dette. La seule façon de gagner le "Tomodachi Game", c’est de ne jamais douter de ses proches. Mais leur amitié va être mise à rude épreuve… Vont-ils se faire confiance ou se trahir entre-eux ?

1.title: FR - Memory of a Killer [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: After carrying out a hit on his latest assigned target, Angelo begins to realize his mind may be failing him as his two, completely separate lives are slowly crashing together.

1.title: FR - Memory of a Killer [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - Uncle Jacob
1.plot: Haunted by fractured memories, Angelo questions his perception of reality. Joe helps Angelo plan a high-tech public assassination of a Russian mob accountant who is about to testify on live TV. Detective Woods investigates one of Angelo's murders, bringing him one step closer to uncovering Angelo's secret life.

1.title: FR - Memory of a Killer [VOSTFR] - S01E07 - Dr. Parks
1.plot: Angelo learns that a previous job may be the key to unmasking The Ferryman. Meanwhile, Dave has a big break in his investigation that could expose Angelo's true identity.

1.title: FR - Memory of a Killer [VOSTFR] - S01E08 - Tailored by Fabroni
1.plot: Major revelations threaten to upend Angelo's family. Joe gets the opportunity of a lifetime.

1.title: FR - Memory of a Killer [VOSTFR] - S01E09 - Shoot the Piano Player
1.plot: After a stunning reveal, Angelo races against the clock to protect the ones he loves from The Ferryman's path of death and destruction.

meta.plot: Angelo Ledda mène une double vie : tueur à gages redoutable à New York et vendeur de photocopieurs et père de famille paisible à Cooperstown, dans le nord de l'État de New York. Toutes deux sont menacées lorsqu'on lui diagnostique la maladie d'Alzheimer, une maladie qui lui a déjà coûté son frère aîné.

1.title: FR - Fullmetal Alchemist - S01E21 - The Red Glow

1.title: FR - Fullmetal Alchemist - S01E22 - Created Human

1.title: FR - Fullmetal Alchemist - S01E23 - Heart of Steel
1.plot: Edward upsets Winry with his refusal to talk, and Alphonse decides to confront Edward with his questions about artificial souls.

1.plot: Alphonse runs off and comes face to face with Scar, who's been hiding out among the mercenary-plagued refugees of Ishbal.

1.title: FR - Fullmetal Alchemist - S01E34 - Theory of Avarice
