1.title: FR - Fullmetal Alchemist - S01E35 - Reunion of the Fallen
1.plot: As Edward and Alphonse head out to the Ishbal camp with Winry, Lust is sitting down at a restaurant when a man from her past enters the room.

1.title: FR - Fullmetal Alchemist - S01E36 - The Sinner Within
1.plot: Ed and Alphonse hope to learn more about the Philosopher's Stone when they lend a hand to a group of Ishbalan refugees being shipped further south.

1.title: FR - Fullmetal Alchemist - S01E37 - The Flame Alchemist, The Bachelor Lieutenant & The Mystery of Warehouse 13
1.plot: While he investigates Mustang, Lt. Havoc orders his man Falman to find him a girlfriend. Later, Mustang must investigate the haunted Warehouse 13.

1.title: FR - Fullmetal Alchemist - S01E38 - With the River's Flow
1.plot: After an argument splits up Ed, Al and Winry, Al bumps into a familiar face, and Winry decides to investigate Hughes' murder with Sheska.

1.title: FR - Fullmetal Alchemist - S01E39 - Secret of Ishbal
1.plot: Kimblee is named State Alchemist and heads out with the troops to Liore, where Scar is gouging out the earth with a large stone.

1.title: FR - Fullmetal Alchemist - S01E40 - The Scar
1.plot: After Lust and Gluttony drop in on Edward's confrontation with Scar in Liore, the seventh and final homunculus is finally revealed.

1.title: FR - Fullmetal Alchemist - S01E41 - Holy Mother
1.plot: With the help of Rose, the Holy Mother, Scar instructs the inhabitants of Liore not to provoke violence as they lure the military into town.

1.title: FR - Fullmetal Alchemist - S01E42 - His Name Is Unknown
1.plot: With Ed busy aiding the people of Liore, Scar is the only one who can help Alphonse when his armor begins transforming into an explosive compound.

1.title: FR - Fullmetal Alchemist - S01E43 - The Stray Dog
1.plot: While the Elric Brothers flee Liore, Winry meets a complete stranger in Resembool who is later introduced to her as Ed and Al's father.

1.title: FR - Fullmetal Alchemist - S01E44 - Hohenheim of Light
1.plot: As the Elrics' father, Hohenhelm of Light, sets out to confront the leader of the Homunculi, Lyra and Rose find a secret stairway in an old church.

1.title: FR - Fullmetal Alchemist - S01E45 - A Rotted Heart
1.plot: A complex and entangled history reveals itself as Van Hohenheim of Light battles Dante, the leader of the Homunculi.

1.title: FR - Fullmetal Alchemist - S01E46 - Human Transmutation
1.plot: The brothers are in danger when they become separated. Ed returns to Dante's mansion to look for clues. Al meets with the deranged Shou Tucker.

1.title: FR - Fullmetal Alchemist - S01E47 - Sealing the Homunculus
1.plot: Wrath believes that Sloth is his real mother. Sloth battles Shou Tucker. Ed realizes that Al has been tricked by Tucker.

1.title: FR - Fullmetal Alchemist - S01E48 - Goodbye
1.plot: Armstrong declares an uprising against the Führer on the northern border while Ed, joined by Izumi, fights the remaining Homunculi in Central.

1.title: FR - Fullmetal Alchemist - S01E49 - The Other Side of the Gate
1.plot: King Bradley comes home to give his son a birthday gift. Edward meets with Russell in an abandoned church. Maria and Denny arrive to support Izumi.

1.title: FR - Fullmetal Alchemist - S01E50 - Death
1.plot: Edward Elric arrives in World War I after being pulled through the Gate. Roy Mustang confronts his enemy, Homunculus Pride.

1.title: FR - Fullmetal Alchemist - S01E51 - Laws and Promises
1.plot: Edward Elric realizes he must make the ultimate sacrifice if he wants to retrieve his brother from the Gate. Hawkeye breaks free from her captors.

meta.plot:
Les frères Elric (Edward et Alphonse) ont hérité leur talent d’alchimiste de leur père qui a quitté le foyer familial sans jamais revenir.

À la suite de la mort de leur mère, les deux jeunes tentent de la faire revivre grâce à l'alchimie, en faisant une transmutation humaine malgré l'interdit. L'opération échoue et les deux frères en subissent le contrecoup… Al disparaît et Ed perd sa jambe mais sauve son frère privé de son corps en fixant son esprit dans le corps en métal d'une armure médiévale avec un cercle de transmutation tracé avec son sang, mais doit pour cela sacrifier un bras. Par la suite, il utilisera des prothèses mécaniques en métal, les mécagreffes (1er doublage) ou automails (second doublage).

Ed passe ensuite l'examen et devient Alchimiste d'État, afin de pouvoir voyager et trouver la pierre philosophale, pour que son frère et lui retrouvent leur corps.

1.title: FR - Domino Day - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Domino Day is a 24-year-old Londoner out on a date with finance bro Jason in a swanky Manchester bar. She works as a barista in a local coffee bar and also happens to be a witch. The type of witch who needs to feed...

1.title: FR - Domino Day - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Local coven leader Kat lures Domino to her HQ, where her ancestors possess Domino and reveal the dark truth about who she really is.

1.title: FR - Domino Day - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Domino struggles with the reappearance of her dangerous ex, who wants to pick up where they left off. Meanwhile, the coven grapples with the truth of who Domino is.

1.title: FR - Domino Day - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: With her powers becoming uncontrollably dangerous and having put Sammie in danger, Domino is forced to confront the monster within herself and ask the coven for help.

1.title: FR - Domino Day - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Happily free of both Silas and her power, a ‘human’ Domino enjoys a date with Leon. But a jealous Silas and tenacious Esme won’t let things lie, and her life is soon upended again.

1.title: FR - Domino Day - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Domino regains her powers while Silas lures her into a trap using the coven. Determined to revive Leon and save her friends, Domino faces an explosive showdown with Esme.

meta.plot: Jeune sorcière dotée de pouvoirs extraordinaires, Domino cherche désespérément une communauté qui l'aiderait à comprendre qui elle est. Elle n'a pourtant pas besoin de chercher bien loin, car un coven de sorcières surveille déjà chacun de ses mouvements, convaincu qu'il faut l'arrêter avant que ses pouvoirs ne détruisent tout et tout le monde autour d'elle.

1.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: After surviving a terrifying night lost in a forest, four mismatched teenage boys return home to find that things aren’t quite as they left them.

1.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: The boys grapple with the discovery that they are now total strangers to their friends and families. Banding together, they try to get to the bottom of their terrifying predicament.

1.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: The boys’ desperation to prove they still exist leads Sam to discover his doppelgänger.

1.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Andy’s obsession with finding a rational explanation nearly comes to grief under the wheels of the school bus.

1.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Felix discovers the other boys unwittingly possess the magic needed to fight the evil thing that is threatening them.

1.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Jake comes face to face with the father he never had, as Phoebe lays claim to the four boys.

1.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Sam must face up to his flaws as the demon unleashes its most brazen attack yet - on Bremin High.

1.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: The boys discover the truth about Phoebe as the demon evolves to take on human form.

1.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S01E09 - Episode 9
1.plot: A trip back to the forest presents both a chance to return home as well as redemption for Andy.

1.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S01E10 - Episode 10
1.plot: Sam’s loyalty to the boys is tested to the limit when the demon targets his girlfriend, Mia.

1.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S01E11 - Episode 11
1.plot: The boys' problems are compounded when their parallel mothers all succumb to mysterious afflictions.

1.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S01E12 - Episode 12
1.plot: The boys are shattered to learn who is responsible for everything that’s happened to them.

1.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S01E13 - Episode 13
1.plot: The demon closes in for the kill as the boys finally work out how to return home.

2.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S02E01 - Episode 1
2.plot: Felix, Andy, Jake and Sam have returned home, but still the universe seems out of balance. Felix is concerned that Alice has followed them back and Andy hopes his new power will get Ellen to notice him.

2.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S02E02 - Episode 2
2.plot: Felix, Jake and Sam race against time to get Andy back from the storm that took him - before anyone notices he's missing again.

2.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S02E03 - Episode 3
2.plot: Pressure mounts on Felix, Jake and Sam as they are questioned by the police about Andy's disappearance. Meanwhile, Oscar tries to locate the Book of Shadows by making a connection to Alice.

2.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S02E04 - Episode 4
2.plot: After being beaten to Alice's Book of Shadows, Felix theorises that if they find another water element, they should regain their ability to use magic. So the boys go on the hunt for the new element.

2.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S02E05 - Episode 5
2.plot: With Saskia, their new water element, the boys do a spell to find Andy but it backfires landing Jake in serious trouble.

2.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S02E06 - Episode 6
2.plot: The search for Andy takes Felix, Jake, Sam and Ellen back to the alternate universe. But they have to be quick, Felix fears the restoring demon isn't far behind them.

2.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S02E07 - Episode 7
2.plot: Overwhelmed, Ellen tries to process their journey to the other universe and refuses to talk to Felix, while Jake is shocked to discover that Cop Gary has followed them through the portal.

2.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S02E08 - Episode 8
2.plot: The talisman is missing - Jake and Felix are at loggerheads as to where it is. Could Saskia be to blame? Meanwhile, Andy meets a cloaked figure while trying to find a way out of negative space.

2.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S02E09 - Episode 9
2.plot: The gang discover Andy is trapped in Negative Space due to Alice hacking Andy's spell; and Alice lures Oscar to the river and offers to cast a spell to make him walk again.

2.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S02E10 - Episode 10
2.plot: Alice has destroyed the talisman and everyone is in shock - now they have absolutely no way of getting Andy back. Whilst the gang debate this, a figure emerges from the bush...

2.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S02E11 - Episode 11
2.plot: Felix believes that there is a second talisman in their universe because the other talisman came from the alternate universe...and Sam has swapped bodies during the memory-wiping spell. Will the gang realise the truth before it's too late?

2.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S02E12 - Episode 12
2.plot: The gang have the second talisman and are set to bring Andy home, but Alice is determined to stop them. Meanwhile, Andy and Bear are running for their lives as their world collapses around them.

2.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S02E13 - Episode 13
2.plot: With the gang now powerless, Felix has devised his own plan to rescue Andy. He's going to ask Alice to swap him for Andy. Will the rest of the gang realise in time?

3.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S03E01 - The New Boy
3.plot: When people start to vanish on Luke's first day at school, he finds himself thrown together with an unlikely group of friends - the new Nowhere Boys. They must figure out how to save the town from becoming an empty wasteland.

3.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S03E02 - What Happened To Bremin?
3.plot: The Nowhere Boys comb the streets of Bremin for signs of life but find themselves under attack from a mysterious life force.

3.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S03E03 - We Are Not Alone
3.plot: The gang catch their mysterious stalker, who is just as confused by this strange and empty world, as they are.

3.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S03E04 - The Gang Find Magic
3.plot: The gang learn they can do magic & plan to cast a dimensional return spell, which requires sacrificing their heart's desire. They search for Brooklyn but are attacked by a monster, which they fend off using magic.

3.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S03E05 - Bates To The Rescue
3.plot: An unhinged Principal Bates is trying to make everything normal by pretending it is normal. He locks the gang in a classroom, but they finally escape and cast the dimensional return spell - will they get home?

3.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S03E06 - Are We Home Yet?
3.plot: The gang are home & everything is perfect, life couldn't be better, except for Nicco who questions if this really is their Bremin. Discovering they're actually suspended in a dream state the gang manage to wake themselves up.

3.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S03E07 - The Trouble With Ben
3.plot: The gang are definitely back home, but unbeknownst to them there are two Ben's [sic]! One good and one bad - will the gang learn the truth before Bad Ben sends them back to the Empty World?

3.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S03E08 - Back To The Empty World
3.plot: Ben 1 & Ben 2 are stranded in the empty world, & despite our gang successfully bringing them home; Ben 1 still wants to get rid of them. Ben 2 immobilises Ben 1.

3.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S03E09 - The Truth Spell
3.plot: The gang perform a truth spell on Ben 2 to ensure they can always tell the two Bens apart, but the spell backfires when Heath mixes up the words and our gang all have to tell the truth

3.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S03E10 - Unwanted Visitors
3.plot: The Mini Demons come to Bremin High and cause havoc. Our gang catch them and keep them in their school bags, but they exert a negative influence over the gang - can Ben 2 stop them before it's too late?

3.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S03E11 - The Search For Atridax
3.plot: The bags with the Atridax are missing and the gang want to use magic to find them, but Luke's under house arrest. Luke makes a trust deal with his father and the gang retrieve the bags only to have them stolen.

3.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S03E12 - Birth Of The Mega Demon
3.plot: The gang are on the hunt for the missing talisman. They realise Kayla has it, but it's too late, she's been tricked by bad Ben and gets sucked inside the Demon egg. Will Nicco be able to get her sister out?

3.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S03E13 - The Battle For Bremin
3.plot: People are disappearing and all is not right with Nicco's sister, Kayla. Realising she has part of the Demon inside, the gang trek to the forest to fight the Demon while it's incomplete. But Luke's parents have disappeared...

4.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S04E01 - We Are Not Alone Anymore
4.plot: The Nowhere Boys are back and Luke's attempts to convince the Gang that a new threat is imminent are dismissed – until the threat proves too big to ignore.

4.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S04E02 - Secrets, Lies and Parasites
4.plot: As the Gang fights off the latest threat, Jesse's preoccupation with a cyber bully puts their biggest secret at risk. When menacing creatures attack again, the Gang fight back by sending them out of this world – but at what cost?

4.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S04E03 - Lost In Negative Space
4.plot: Nicco jeopardises both the Gang's plan to rescue one of their own and her football ambition - but as Bates closes in, can Nicco redeem herself and save the day?

4.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S04E04 - The Cool Guy
4.plot: Bates is on the warpath. Convinced he is close to exposing a conspiracy gripping Bremin High, he interrogates the Gang. Will one of them crack under the pressure? Meanwhile, the arrival of a stranger puts Heath under the spotlight.

4.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S04E05 - Stranger Danger
4.plot: Desperate to get Felix's book back, the Gang search for Zeb, the mysterious stranger. But when Luke is kidnapped, they all find themselves drawn into a dangerous trap.

4.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S04E06 - Mistaken Id-Entity
4.plot: When a friend suddenly becomes an enemy the Gang are left shaken. Meanwhile Jesse confronts his cyber bully and scores an unexpected win.

4.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S04E07 - Keep Your Friends Close
4.plot: While the gang do battle with one of their own, they're forced to face some home truths. But that's not all they learn – did they have Zeb all wrong?

4.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S04E08 - Off the Map
4.plot: The Nowhere Boys take a wrong turn in their quest to find Zeb, landing them in danger and on the run. Meanwhile Ben and Ellen decode clues left by Zeb and try to find a way to bring them home.

4.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S04E09 - Doubles Trouble
4.plot: Captured, Nicco and Luke are interrogated and forced to confront alternate versions of themselves. Heath and Jesse learn that their friends are imprisoned in a high-security facility and plan a breakout.

4.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S04E10 - Attack of the Nematodes
4.plot: The Gang and their doubles join forces to try and escape their captors amidst increasing Nematode attacks, but can they repair the Talisman in time to avert tragedy and find their way home?

4.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S04E11 - The Chosen One
4.plot: The Gang contact Zeb and learn that one of them is the all-powerful Guardian of the multiverse and must travel to Negative Space to save theirs and all worlds from the Entity, the most powerful enemy they've ever faced. But who really is the Guardian.

4.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S04E12 - The Alternate World is Here
4.plot: With the Guardian in Negative Space, the Gang believe they have saved the multiverse until a catastrophic event at Bremin High suggests otherwise. Will the Gang be forced to expose their powers and magic in order to save the school?

4.title: FR - Boys : entre deux mondes - S04E13 - The Entity Face Off
4.plot: The gang arrive in Negative Space for a final showdown with the Entity – the fate of the multiverse is in their hands. If only the Guardian could rembember the plan.

meta.plot: Lors d'une sortie découverte avec le lycée, quatre lycéens se perdent en forêt et passent la nuit dans les bois. Lorsqu'ils rentrent enfin chez eux, le lendemain, leur famille ne les reconnaît plus. Que s'est-il passé dans cette forêt, cette nuit-là ? Entre incompréhension et stupeur, les quatre adolescents décident de mener leur propre enquête.

1.title: FR - Marshals - S01E01 - Piya Wiconi
1.plot: Kayce Dutton reunites with an old SEAL teammate and aids his Marshal unit in hunting down a bomber targeting Broken Rock Reservation. The trail leads to a dangerous encounter with an armed anti-government militia.

1.title: FR - Marshals - S01E02 - Zone of Death
1.plot: As Kayce tries to embrace his new beginning, a Marshals op to stop a domestic terror attack lands him in a valley of buried Dutton family skeletons. While confronting his past, he must also learn to ingratiate himself with his new Marshals teammates.

1.title: FR - Marshals - S01E03 - Road to Nowhere
1.plot: When a standoff between Broken Rock and local ranchers over a mine groundbreaking turns violent, the Marshals launch a manhunt to find the shooters.

1.title: FR - Marshals - S01E04 - The Gathering Storm
1.plot: Kayce and Cal search for survivors of a helicopter crash while the rest of the team tries to clear Kayce's name in a use of force complaint.

1.title: FR - Marshals - S01E05 - Lost Girls (1)
1.plot: When Kayce and Tate cross paths with an old friend of Tate's from the rez, Hayley, who exhibits behavior consistent with a trafficking victim, Kayce throws himself into tracking her down rather than committing to commemorating Monica.

1.title: FR - Marshals - S01E06 - Out of the Shadows (2)
1.plot: After losing the trail of teen trafficking victims, Kayce must tell Tate that his friend may be gone for good. When the Marshals learn the girls are in the hands of a violent motorcycle gang, they launch a dangerous op to infiltrate the gang.

1.title: FR - Marshals - S01E07 - Family Business
1.plot: When a federal judge and her family are the targets of a car bomb, the Marshals are assigned to guard them. Family secrets start to surface as the Marshals start to look into why someone would want this family dead.

1.title: FR - Marshals - S01E08 - Blowback
1.plot: The Marshals go manhunting after receiving a tip that a dangerous fugitive is on the loose. Kayce and Cal struggle to reckon with their time at war when a former SEAL brother, Garrett, drifts back into their lives as they hunt a vicious enemy.

meta.plot: Le ranch du Yellowstone derrière lui, Kayce Dutton rejoint une unité des U.S. Marhals. Cowboy et ancien Navy SEAL, il apporte la justice dans le Montana. Lui et ses coéquipiers sont le dernier rempart de la région dans la guerre contre la violence.

1.title: FR - DTF St. Louis - S01E01 - Cornhole
1.plot: When Clark and Floyd learn that both their marriages have stalled, they begin to explore a new dating app for extramarital affairs.

1.title: FR - DTF St. Louis - S01E02 - Snag It
1.plot: After meeting at the cornhole party, Clark quickly hits it off with Floyd's wife Carol. Later, detectives Homer and Plumb dig deeper into Clark's relationship with Carol – and Floyd's time on the DTF app.

1.title: FR - DTF St. Louis - S01E03 - The Go Getter
1.plot: When Detective Plumb discovers that Carol has lied about key details of her affair, she presses Homer to let her question Clark. Once in the hot seat, unsettling truths about Clark's relationships with both Floyd and Carol begin to come to light.

1.title: FR - DTF St. Louis - S01E04 - Missouri Mutual Life & Health Insurance Company
1.plot: Eager to please, Clark ramps up his support for Floyd's health and financial wellness, while Carol makes her lover swear to secrecy.

meta.plot: Dans cette série à l'humour noir, un triangle amoureux entre trois adultes en proie au mal-être de la quarantaine conduit à la mort de l'un d'eux.

1.title: FR - Colosio: Assassinats Politiques [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Episode 1

meta.plot: Cette série documentaire se penche sur l'un des événements politiques les plus controversés du Mexique : l'assassinat, en 1994, du candidat à la présidence Luis Donaldo Colosio. Elle explore l'enquête, les contradictions et les questions restées sans réponse qui entourent cette affaire.

1.title: FR - R.J. Decker [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: After a stint in prison, disgraced photographer RJ Decker returns to South Florida to reinvent himself as a private investigator. His first case pulls him into the eccentric and corrupt world of professional bass fishing, where he must navigate local conspiracies with the help of his journalist ex-wife and a mysterious Everglades hermit.

1.title: FR - R.J. Decker [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - Twenty Pounds of Clem in a Ten-Pound Bag
1.plot: Wish enlists RJ's help on a bizarre case when his late cellmate's son is wrongly accused of murder.

1.title: FR - R.J. Decker [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - The Needle and the Damage Done
1.plot: R.J. is recruited by Emi to investigate the disappearance of a wealthy rehab tycoon's son; Mel and Catherine discover they have different views on parenting and finances.

1.title: FR - R.J. Decker [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - In Vanity Veritas
1.plot: R.J. finds himself at the center of a suburban housewife murder mystery; Catherine worries that R.J. is getting too close to Emi.

meta.plot: RJ Decker, photographe de presse et ancien détenu tombé en disgrâce, se lance en tant que détective privé dans le milieu criminel haut en couleur du sud de la Floride. Il s'attaque à des affaires aussi étranges que bizarres, avec l'aide de son ex journaliste, de sa femme, inspectrice de police, et d'une mystérieuse nouvelle bienfaitrice, une femme de son passé qui pourrait bien être sa plus grande alliée… ou son aller simple pour la prison.

1.title: FR - L'École des licornes : Révélations - S01E01 - Un-Welcome Back
1.plot: Back at the academy, Sophia wrestles with her guilt about the past as a dazzling Fairy Tiara sparks a quest for six gems to defend the island.

1.title: FR - L'École des licornes : Révélations - S01E02 - The Fairy Gemstones
1.plot: Valentina tells the tale of how unicorn magic began as the crew finds a map showing where the gems are, pointing to Whispering Willows and Prism Beach.

1.title: FR - L'École des licornes : Révélations - S01E03 - Sneaky Snookers
1.plot: With the next Fairy Gemstone on the line, an intense training game against the Rubies turns dangerous — and the Sapphires test how far they'll go to win.

1.title: FR - L'École des licornes : Révélations - S01E04 - Sick and Fired
1.plot: While Val's sick in bed, the crew sets out on a swashbuckling quest up Mount Equus that brings grim illusions, forcing the Sapphires to trust each other.

1.title: FR - L'École des licornes : Révélations - S01E05 - The Grirnorian Gambit
1.plot: Drawn into Grimoria in search of the final gem, the Sapphires face dark enchantments and a leadership clash that puts their unicoms and mission at risk.

1.title: FR - L'École des licornes : Révélations - S01E06 - Big Trouble
1.plot: Wildstars brush with grim magic brings a healer with a familiar face, while a hurtful betrayal leaves Sophia with a choice that could change everything.

1.title: FR - L'École des licornes : Révélations - S01E07 - The Solaira Festival
1.plot: With the Solaira Festival afoot, Sophia braves dark magic and a secret alliance to save her friends as Serena's spellbinding show puts everyone in peril.

1.title: FR - L'École des licornes : Révélations - S01E08 - The Fairy Tiara
1.plot: While Serena and Ravenzella battle for the Fairy Tiara, the Sapphires leam its true power. Is their bond the key to restoring Unicorn Island's magic?

meta.plot: Une nouvelle année apporte son lot de mystères magiques, et une aventure audacieuse met le courage des Saphirs à l'épreuve. C'est la rentrée à l'École des licornes!

1.title: FR - Peaky Blinders - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Birmingham, 1919. Thomas Shelby controls the Peaky Blinders, one of the city's most feared criminal organisations, but his ambitions go beyond running the streets. When a crate of guns goes missing, Thomas recognises an opportunity to move up in the world.

1.title: FR - Peaky Blinders - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Thomas fixes a horserace, provoking the ire of local kingpin Billy Kimber. He also starts a war with gypsy family the Lees. Meanwhile, Inspector Campbell carries out a vicious raid of Small Heath in search of the stolen guns.

1.title: FR - Peaky Blinders - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Thomas Shelby plans to go to Cheltenham races in order to get closer to Billy Kimber. Knowing the gangster's appetite for beautiful women, Thomas invites Grace to accompany him. Meanwhile some IRA sympathisers approach Thomas with an offer to buy the stolen guns.

1.title: FR - Peaky Blinders - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Thomas Shelby's war with the Lee family of gypsies escalates, and Campbell puts further pressure on him to deliver the stolen guns. Meanwhile Thomas's brother John plans to marry a former prostitute, but Thomas suspects that she's still on the game.

1.title: FR - Peaky Blinders - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Thomas Shelby has to deal with an IRA chief who has come to Small Heath to avenge his cousin's death. Meanwhile Campbell gets closer to the stolen guns, and Grace has to decide whether her loyalties lie with him or with Thomas.

1.title: FR - Peaky Blinders - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: As Thomas Shelby prepares to oust Billy Kimber, hidden secrets are revealed and the family have to face up to the problems that have divided them. Meanwhile, Campbell, obsessed with taking down the Peaky Blinders, unleashes one last plan to destroy them.

2.title: FR - Peaky Blinders - S02E01 - Episode 1
2.plot: Business is booming for the Peaky Blinders, as Shelby starts expanding both his legal and illegal operations. He plans for the future, looking at managing a race track in the South. He soon comes across some new adversaries, testing him in very different ways. Back in Birmingham, Shelby's home town is challenged by members of his family reacting to the upturn in their fortunes. A enemy from his past also returns hoping to exact their plan of revenge of biblical proportions.

2.title: FR - Peaky Blinders - S02E02 - Episode 2
2.plot: Tommy offers to help Polly by searching for her children, who long ago were taken from her. In London, Tommy risks his life by meeting enigmatic leader Alfie Solomons. Meanwhile Arthur continues to feel the devastating effects of the Great War.

2.title: FR - Peaky Blinders - S02E03 - Episode 3
2.plot: Tommy hatches a plan to take control of the southern racecourses. He also meets the aristocratic May Carleton, and sees an opportunity to move up in the world. Meanwhile both Major Campbell and London gangster Darby Sabini plan Tommy's downfall.

2.title: FR - Peaky Blinders - S02E04 - Episode 4
2.plot: Arthur leads the Peaky Blinders takeover of London's Eden Club. Sabini decides to put old feuds to one side, convincing Alfie to one side to get rid of the Peaky Blinders. Tommy hires May Carleton to train his race horse, and the pair become fast friends. In Birmingham, Michael joins the family firm, hoping to help Tommy's businesses become more legitimate. Whilst Tommy's insecurities are intensified as he discovers what Major Campbell wants him to do.

2.title: FR - Peaky Blinders - S02E05 - Episode 5
2.plot: Arthur and Michael both end up arrested and imprisoned. As Tommy's base in London is obliterated. Major Campbell has Tommy and his family under his thumb. Polly compromises herself hoping to secure Michael's freedom, but their relationship may be beyond repair at this point. Someone from Tommy's past pays him a visit, opening old wounds and leaving him to make a impossible decision.

2.title: FR - Peaky Blinders - S02E06 - Episode 6
2.plot: As derby day arrives, Tommy is faced with impossible decisions as he plans to strike back at his enemies and take the family business to another level. Meanwhile, Major Campbell has one final card to play - one that he is certain will bring about Tommy's demise.

3.title: FR - Peaky Blinders - S03E01 - Episode 1
3.plot: Thomas Shelby’s wedding day has arrived at last, but while his guests enjoy the celebrations he has important business to conduct, as a mysterious stranger makes their presence known.

3.title: FR - Peaky Blinders - S03E02 - Episode 2
3.plot: Tommy goes to London to meet the wildly eccentric and volatile Duke Leon and soon discovers the extreme lengths his new paymasters are willing to go to in their quest for power. In Birmingham a personal dispute with the Italians threatens to explode into a devastating war.

3.title: FR - Peaky Blinders - S03E03 - Episode 3
3.plot: Responding to the Italians’ actions, Tommy is set on a path of deadly vengeance that could take him to his darkest place yet, and threatens to splinter the family. As Arthur struggles with his conscience, Linda implores him to stop his illicit work with the Peaky Blinders.

3.title: FR - Peaky Blinders - S03E04 - Episode 4
3.plot: Tommy takes his brothers on a hunting expedition and shares some  important family news. He also outlines his intentions for the most  daring criminal act the Peaky Blinders have ever undertaken.

3.title: FR - Peaky Blinders - S03E05 - Episode 5
3.plot: As the Russians test the Peaky Blinders men in their own distinctive and  debauched way, Tommy realises that he is being seriously outmanoeuvred.  Desperate for help, he rekindles a business relationship with a  dangerous former acquaintance.

3.title: FR - Peaky Blinders - S03E06 - Episode 6
3.plot: As Tommy prepares to commit the most audacious crime  of his career, an unexpected blow is struck, putting him under  unbearable pressure. As he faces his worst fears he needs help more than ever, but is increasingly uncertain about whom he can trust. In a nerve-shredding race against time, Tommy is forced to confront  hard truths about himself and his family that could change the Peaky  Blinders forever.

4.title: FR - Peaky Blinders - S04E01 - The Noose
4.plot: December 1925. When Tommy receives a mysterious letter on Christmas Eve, he realises that the Shelbys are in danger of annihilation.

4.title: FR - Peaky Blinders - S04E02 - Heathens
4.plot: As the Shelbys come to terms with the shocking events of Christmas Day, Tommy endeavours to unite his family and a bold new enemy makes his move.

4.title: FR - Peaky Blinders - S04E03 - Blackbird

À cette équipe déjà tissée serrée s’ajoute Zoé (Estelle Fournier), la fille de 18 ans de Clovis qu’il n’a jamais vraiment connue. Entre les défis financiers, les tensions en cuisine, les secrets bien gardés et les rivalités inattendues, Clovis doit apprendre à devenir plus qu’un chef : un véritable pilier pour cette brigade qu’il a réuni dans sa cuisine.

meta.plot:
Eric et Ramzy convient 4 de leurs plus grands fans en Espagne sur le tournage de leur nouvelle série : Zorro. Pendant 5 jours, nous les suivons en train de découvrir les coulisses de ce tournage incroyable, mais aussi de s’affronter dans un jeu complètement dingue destiné à répondre à la question suivante : lequel d’entre eux est LE plus grand fan ? À la clé : 20 000€ pour le gagnant. Seul détail : tout est totalement faux, créé de toute pièce pour organiser un gigantesque prank ! Et toutes les personnes impliquées sont des comédiens… Toutes, sauf Boris. Persuadé d’assister à un tournage plus vrai que nature, Boris va vivre la semaine la plus folle de sa vie sous l’oeil de 40 caméras cachées.

Et grâce à la complicité de Laurent Lafitte, Hafid Benamar, Niels Schneider, Youssef Hajdi, Jean-Pascal Zadi, Laura Felpin, Melha Bedia et Marc Labrèche il va se retrouver plongé dans des situations aussi invraisemblables que délirantes !

1.plot: When a known smuggler is flagged at the New York border with unidentified cargo, Colin and Bill head upstate to track. To find this smuggler, they must enlist the help of a foreign intelligence officer looking to defect.

1.plot: After Colin receives a tip on an upcoming terror plot, the team recovers a young man who was kidnapped nine years ago in Turkey and dig into his time in captivity to help stop the attack. Meanwhile, Bill looks into someone very close to Colin.

meta.plot: Lorsque deux partenaires improbables - un agent de la CIA à la langue bien pendue et qui ne respecte pas les règles, et un agent du FBI expérimenté et intelligent qui croit en l'État de droit - sont affectés au poste de la CIA à New York, ils doivent apprendre à travailler ensemble pour enquêter sur les affaires et les criminels qui représentent une menace sur le sol américain, et découvrir que leurs différences peuvent en fait être leur force.

1.title: FR - Le baiser de la sirène - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Woo-seok suggests posing as lovers, and Seol-ah agrees. Jun-beom consigns a painting to her, tension grows, and Woo-seok faces a shocking truth.

1.title: FR - Le baiser de la sirène - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Seol-ah receives a threat and faces danger. Saved by Woo-seok, the two trace links between Paek Jun-beom and Lee Su-ho as Woo-seok is pursued.

1.plot: Seol-ah traces the artwork fire incident to Chair Kim, learns of Woo-seok's wound, and confronts Jun-beom as Woo-seok probes Jun-beom and Su-ho.

1.title: FR - Le baiser de la sirène - S01E08 - Episode 8

1.title: FR - Le baiser de la sirène - S01E10 - Episode 10
1.plot: Woo-seok and Seol-ah find a lead, but a painting raises her suspicion again. She prepares a final strike and enters the secret vault with Woo-seok.

1.title: FR - Le baiser de la sirène - S01E11 - Episode 11
1.plot: Seol-ah steps onto the final auction. She and Woo-seok seem to succeed in revenge, but its pain lingers. Another death warns the tragedy isn't over.

meta.plot: "L'aimer, c'est mourir." Cha Woo-seok, un enquêteur d'assurances, s'intéresse à des morts liées à Han Seol-ah, une commissaire-priseuse. Après la mort d'une collègue et de plusieurs anciens amants de Han Seol-ah, il la soupçonne d'être une victime. Se faisant passer pour un couple afin de découvrir la vérité, ils basculent dans un monde de contrefaçons, de fraudes et de meurtres cupides.

1.title: FR - Small Prophets [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Since his partner Clea went missing seven years ago, Michael Sleep's life has been on hold. But a mystical recipe in an old journal promises answers he’s been longing for.

meta.plot: Depuis la disparition inexpliquée de sa petite amie Clea il y a sept ans, Michael dérive. Lorsque son père déterre une ancienne recette alchimique, Michael tente le tout pour le tout : créer des esprits capables de prédire l’avenir. Aidé de son amie Kacey, il cultive ces créatures dans sa remise, espérant qu’elles répondront à son unique obsession : reverra-t-il Clea ? Mais en s’éveillant, les esprits déclenchent une série d’événements étranges.

meta.plot: Le combat de Tracy Raquel Berns, désignée comme coupable, à l'âge de deux ans, de la mort de son petit frère, afin d'identifier le véritable meurtrier.

Un compte à rebours hilarant où sa vie part totalement en vrille.

FR - Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody - S01E01 - The Catastrophe That Started with a Death March
1.plot: Suzuki Ichirou is a programmer who is working a death march to keep up with nightmare combination of unreasonable deadlines and unreliable coworkers. After crawling under his desk for some much-needed shut-eye, he awakes to find himself in a familiar, but distinct, fantasy world.

1.title: FR - Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody - S01E02 - Exploring a City That Started with a Death March
1.plot: Satou seems to be stuck in the parallel world that looks like an amalgamation of the game projects he's worked on. And while his insider knowledge of the world's systems gives him an advantage, he still needs to find his bearings before he can start planning what to do next. To that end, he heads to the nearest city to establish a base of operations.

1.title: FR - Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody - S01E03 - Love That Started with a Death March
1.plot: Satou is shown around the city by Zena when they encounter demi-human slaves who are being abused by a mob. But prejudice isn't the only problem when everyone suddenly finds themselves deep in a dangerous labyrinth.

1.title: FR - Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody - S01E04 - Labyrinth Exploration That Started with a Death March
1.plot: With the aid of the slaves he was trying to help, Satou gradually starts his trek to escape the labyrinth, and rescue the other people who were trapped with him.

1.title: FR - Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody - S01E05 - The Crazy Princess That Started with a Death March
1.plot: Satou chooses to become Tama, Pochi, and Liz's new master rather than let them return to a life of slavery. He also ends up with the strange sisters Arisa and Lulu, the younger of which seems to have a secret tied to Satou's original world...

1.title: FR - Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody - S01E06 - City Defense That Began with a Death March
1.plot: With five girls now in his care, Satou needs to find more permanent lodging. Unfortunately his real estate ventures will have to wait, as the city comes under attack by giant insects!

1.title: FR - Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody - S01E07 - Camping Lessons That Began with a Death March
1.plot: Satou and the gang make plans to help return the elf girl that he rescued to her home in the forest, but first they need to prepare for the long trip by learning how to rough it outdoors.

1.title: FR - Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody - S01E08 - Immortality That Began with a Death March
1.plot: Mia has been kidnapped, and Satou is hot on the trail of the strange specter that took her. The path leads to the place she originally was rescued from, the massive tower known as the Cradle.

1.title: FR - Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody - S01E09 - Deeply Held Attachment That Started with a Death March
1.plot: Satou reaches the top of the Cradle, but he won't be able to take Mia back before confronting a final challenge... One that will end with a surprising addition to his entourage.

1.title: FR - Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody - S01E10 - The Hunting Song That Started with a Death March
1.plot: The journey to return Mia home begins, giving Satou a chance to experiment with the functionality of the fantasy world during the long trip.

1.title: FR - Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody - S01E11 - The Fantasy Conspiracy That Started with a Death March
1.plot: The journey to take Mia home continues, with Satou running afoul the local nobles by disrupting their scheme involving the distribution of healing potions.

1.title: FR - Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody - S01E12 - A Trip to the Underworld That Started with a Death March
1.plot: Satou has to deliver on an arrangement where countless factors have been twisted against him, but will that be enough to keep him from pulling through?

meta.plot: L’informaticien Ichirô Suzuki, alias Satô, se réveille à l’intérieur du jeu vidéo qu’il était en train de programmer. Comme il connaît bien toutes les fonctions et les recoins du jeu, il se révèle très à l'aise dans ce monde. Cependant, il préfère rester discret à ce sujet et tandis qu’il part à sa découverte, il tente de venir en aide aux différents personnages qu’il croise.
